items.Properties / Flavor: A gracefully curved, single-edged blade engineered for rapid draw cuts and fluid slashing motions. Favored by nimble skirmishers and desert riders, it moves with effortless finesse.
items.Description & Mechanics: A gracefully curved, single-edged blade engineered for rapid draw cuts and fluid slashing motions. Favored by nimble skirmishers and desert riders, it moves with effortless finesse.

items.Properties / Flavor: A double-edged thrusting blade measuring two feet in length with a simple crossguard. Nimble rogues and dual-wielding duelists prize its light balance and rapid striking speed.
items.Description & Mechanics: A double-edged thrusting blade measuring two feet in length with a simple crossguard. Nimble rogues and dual-wielding duelists prize its light balance and rapid striking speed.

items.Properties / Flavor: A slender rapier or longsword crafted with an aerodynamic crossguard and buoyant alchemical alloys. Speaking its command word releases the weapon to hover and fight independently for several rounds.
items.Description & Mechanics: A slender rapier or longsword crafted with an aerodynamic crossguard and buoyant alchemical alloys. Speaking its command word releases the weapon to hover and fight independently for several rounds.

items.Properties / Flavor: A sinister notched blade blackened with necrotic ichor that prevents natural healing. Wounds inflicted by this weapon continue to bleed profusely every round until treated with magical medicine.
items.Description & Mechanics: A sinister notched blade blackened with necrotic ichor that prevents natural healing. Wounds inflicted by this weapon continue to bleed profusely every round until treated with magical medicine.

items.Properties / Flavor: A fearsome two-handed blade forged from red dragon teeth that leaves a trail of embers with every swing. It deals extra fire damage on hit and unleashes a cone of dragon breath when commanded.
items.Description & Mechanics: A fearsome two-handed blade forged from red dragon teeth that leaves a trail of embers with every swing. It deals extra fire damage on hit and unleashes a cone of dragon breath when commanded.

items.Properties / Flavor: A paradoxically forged blade of volcanic obsidian infused with permanent glacial permafrost rime. Striking an opponent inflicts both searing fire and biting cold damage simultaneously.
items.Description & Mechanics: A paradoxically forged blade of volcanic obsidian infused with permanent glacial permafrost rime. Striking an opponent inflicts both searing fire and biting cold damage simultaneously.

items.Properties / Flavor: An ancestral double-ended martial weapon favored by the Valenar elves featuring curved steel scythe-blades on both tips. A trained martial artist wields it in continuous spinning arcs to deliver lightning-fast bonus strikes.
items.Description & Mechanics: An ancestral double-ended martial weapon favored by the Valenar elves featuring curved steel scythe-blades on both tips. A trained martial artist wields it in continuous spinning arcs to deliver lightning-fast bonus strikes.

items.Properties / Flavor: A greatsword whose crossguard is fashioned from the fossilized talons of an ancient blue dragon. It deals extra slashing damage against true dragons and protects the wielder from breath attacks.
items.Description & Mechanics: A greatsword whose crossguard is fashioned from the fossilized talons of an ancient blue dragon. It deals extra slashing damage against true dragons and protects the wielder from breath attacks.

items.Properties / Flavor: An exquisitely curved silver blade balanced so lightly that it seems to slice before you swing. It functions as a +2 magical weapon and grants an additional melee attack as a bonus action every round.
items.Description & Mechanics: An exquisitely curved silver blade balanced so lightly that it seems to slice before you swing. It functions as a +2 magical weapon and grants an additional melee attack as a bonus action every round.

items.Properties / Flavor: A blade sharpened to a molecular monomolecular edge that slices through matter with effortless perfection. It maximizes damage dice against objects and can sever limbs from opposing combatants on critical hits.
items.Description & Mechanics: A blade sharpened to a molecular monomolecular edge that slices through matter with effortless perfection. It maximizes damage dice against objects and can sever limbs from opposing combatants on critical hits.

items.Properties / Flavor: A heavy two-handed sword whose broad cutting edges are bonded with an enduring silver alloy. It delivers devastating cleaving strokes that burn the corrupt flesh of werewolves and night hags.
items.Description & Mechanics: A heavy two-handed sword whose broad cutting edges are bonded with an enduring silver alloy. It delivers devastating cleaving strokes that burn the corrupt flesh of werewolves and night hags.

items.Properties / Flavor: A slender dueling sword featuring a silver-plated thrusting tip and an ornate swept-hilt basket. It allows nimble fencing masters to pierce supernatural horrors with precise silver strikes.
items.Description & Mechanics: A slender dueling sword featuring a silver-plated thrusting tip and an ornate swept-hilt basket. It allows nimble fencing masters to pierce supernatural horrors with precise silver strikes.

items.Properties / Flavor: A double-edged short blade layered with pure silver to combat creatures vulnerable to sacred metals. It moves swiftly in off-hand fighting, ensuring reliable damage against fiends and shapeshifters.
items.Description & Mechanics: A double-edged short blade layered with pure silver to combat creatures vulnerable to sacred metals. It moves swiftly in off-hand fighting, ensuring reliable damage against fiends and shapeshifters.

items.Properties / Flavor: A rapier whose blade is composed of liquid mercury held in rigid aerodynamic tension by magnetic magic. It bends around enemy shields to strike exposed vulnerabilities, delivering armor-piercing critical strikes.
items.Description & Mechanics: A rapier whose blade is composed of liquid mercury held in rigid aerodynamic tension by magnetic magic. It bends around enemy shields to strike exposed vulnerabilities, delivering armor-piercing critical strikes.

items.Properties / Flavor: A needle-thin dueling sword forged from glacial ice-steel that leaves frost rime on the floor. Thrusting into a foe chills their muscles, slowing their movement and imposing cold damage.
items.Description & Mechanics: A needle-thin dueling sword forged from glacial ice-steel that leaves frost rime on the floor. Thrusting into a foe chills their muscles, slowing their movement and imposing cold damage.

items.Properties / Flavor: A curved slashing blade carved from the serrated tooth of a territorial mountain drake. It strikes with swift draconic fury, dealing bonus fire damage and cleaving through hides.
items.Description & Mechanics: A curved slashing blade carved from the serrated tooth of a territorial mountain drake. It strikes with swift draconic fury, dealing bonus fire damage and cleaving through hides.

items.Properties / Flavor: A slender, lightweight piercing blade fitted with an oversized circular basket hilt for small hands. It balances with agile precision, allowing nimble duelists to parry heavy weapons effortlessly.
items.Description & Mechanics: A slender, lightweight piercing blade fitted with an oversized circular basket hilt for small hands. It balances with agile precision, allowing nimble duelists to parry heavy weapons effortlessly.

items.Properties / Flavor: This +1 rapier serves as a bardic spellcasting focus and adds your Charisma modifier to weapon damage rolls when you sing in battle. Slender silvery fuller grooves are tuned to whistle harmonic chords with every thrust.
items.Description & Mechanics: This +1 rapier serves as a bardic spellcasting focus and adds your Charisma modifier to weapon damage rolls when you sing in battle. Slender silvery fuller grooves are tuned to whistle harmonic chords with every thrust.

items.Properties / Flavor: This +1 shortsword deals an extra 1d6 cold damage and reduces the target's movement speed by ten feet until their next turn. Frost coats the razor edge of this pale steel blade, exhaling freezing mist into the air.
items.Description & Mechanics: This +1 shortsword deals an extra 1d6 cold damage and reduces the target's movement speed by ten feet until their next turn. Frost coats the razor edge of this pale steel blade, exhaling freezing mist into the air.

items.Properties / Flavor: This +2 curved sword passes through mundane armor, dealing force damage instead of slashing and ignoring shield bonuses. Translucent cosmic glass sparkles with tiny distant stars along its razor-thin edge.
items.Description & Mechanics: This +2 curved sword passes through mundane armor, dealing force damage instead of slashing and ignoring shield bonuses. Translucent cosmic glass sparkles with tiny distant stars along its razor-thin edge.

items.Properties / Flavor: A polished brass shield embossed with the vigilant image of a wide-open watchful eye. Wielding it grants advantage on initiative rolls and wisdom perception checks.
items.Description & Mechanics: A polished brass shield embossed with the vigilant image of a wide-open watchful eye. Wielding it grants advantage on initiative rolls and wisdom perception checks.

items.Properties / Flavor: A heavy kite shield inlaid with silver runes that hovers independently upon a spoken command word. It orbits the user to protect their flank, leaving both hands completely free for weapons.
items.Description & Mechanics: A heavy kite shield inlaid with silver runes that hovers independently upon a spoken command word. It orbits the user to protect their flank, leaving both hands completely free for weapons.

items.Properties / Flavor: A masterwork platinum-rimmed shield that hums with potent, woven abjuration counter-frequencies. It grants advantage on saving throws against all spells and forces spell attacks against you to have disadvantage.
items.Description & Mechanics: A masterwork platinum-rimmed shield that hums with potent, woven abjuration counter-frequencies. It grants advantage on saving throws against all spells and forces spell attacks against you to have disadvantage.

items.Properties / Flavor: A round steel shield emblazoned with a sculpted facial visage that shifts expression upon command. The wielder can change its grimace from jovial laughter to terrifying battle rage as a bonus action.
items.Description & Mechanics: A round steel shield emblazoned with a sculpted facial visage that shifts expression upon command. The wielder can change its grimace from jovial laughter to terrifying battle rage as a bonus action.

items.Properties / Flavor: A concave bronze buckler that generates an invisible localized magnetic ward against missile fire. It grants extra armor class against ranged weapon attacks and pulls arrows aimed at nearby allies toward itself.
items.Description & Mechanics: A concave bronze buckler that generates an invisible localized magnetic ward against missile fire. It grants extra armor class against ranged weapon attacks and pulls arrows aimed at nearby allies toward itself.

items.Properties / Flavor: A kite shield polished to a golden mirror finish that radiates warm, welcoming sunlight in darkness. It sheds bright light that harms vampires and can flash brilliant illumination to blind foes.
items.Description & Mechanics: A kite shield polished to a golden mirror finish that radiates warm, welcoming sunlight in darkness. It sheds bright light that harms vampires and can flash brilliant illumination to blind foes.

items.Properties / Flavor: A lightweight buckler fashioned from rare Xen'drik darkwood that provides the strength of forged steel. It imposes no armor penalties and floats effortlessly on water surfaces.
items.Description & Mechanics: A lightweight buckler fashioned from rare Xen'drik darkwood that provides the strength of forged steel. It imposes no armor penalties and floats effortlessly on water surfaces.

items.Properties / Flavor: A round buckler sculpted with a roaring golden lion head with glowing topaz eyes. Bashing an enemy emits a deafening lion's roar that frightens nearby foes and knocks the target prone.
items.Description & Mechanics: A round buckler sculpted with a roaring golden lion head with glowing topaz eyes. Bashing an enemy emits a deafening lion's roar that frightens nearby foes and knocks the target prone.

items.Properties / Flavor: A convex pavise shield sculpted from the hardened skull plate of a mature subterranean landshark. Planting the shield into earth grants tremorsense and allows you to burrow ten feet under cover.
items.Description & Mechanics: A convex pavise shield sculpted from the hardened skull plate of a mature subterranean landshark. Planting the shield into earth grants tremorsense and allows you to burrow ten feet under cover.

items.Properties / Flavor: When a melee attacker misses you while you wield this shield, thorny tendrils lash out to deal 1d4 piercing damage to the aggressor. Living briars are tightly bound around an ironwood boss that never withers.
items.Description & Mechanics: When a melee attacker misses you while you wield this shield, thorny tendrils lash out to deal 1d4 piercing damage to the aggressor. Living briars are tightly bound around an ironwood boss that never withers.

items.Properties / Flavor: While holding this shield, you can breathe underwater and gain a swimming speed equal to your walking speed. Ancient bronze plating is encrusted with luminescent barnacles and engraved with triton heraldry.
items.Description & Mechanics: While holding this shield, you can breathe underwater and gain a swimming speed equal to your walking speed. Ancient bronze plating is encrusted with luminescent barnacles and engraved with triton heraldry.

items.Properties / Flavor: Holding this shield grants a +1 bonus to AC and gives you advantage on saving throws against psionic charms and telepathic spells. Faceted hexagonal crysteel panes are fitted into a seamless silver lattice frame.
items.Description & Mechanics: Holding this shield grants a +1 bonus to AC and gives you advantage on saving throws against psionic charms and telepathic spells. Faceted hexagonal crysteel panes are fitted into a seamless silver lattice frame.

items.Properties / Flavor: This buckler allows the wielder to deliver a 1d6 piercing shield bash attack as a bonus action following a melee strike. A conical steel center spike juts out from a reinforced disc of hardened ironwood and bronze.
items.Description & Mechanics: This buckler allows the wielder to deliver a 1d6 piercing shield bash attack as a bonus action following a melee strike. A conical steel center spike juts out from a reinforced disc of hardened ironwood and bronze.

items.Properties / Flavor: Forged by the empire of Dhakaan, this +1 greatsword disrupts alien aberrant flesh and scores critical hits on an 19 or 20 against aberrations. Lustrous plum-colored byeshk metal is etched with goblinoid war honorifics.
items.Description & Mechanics: Forged by the empire of Dhakaan, this +1 greatsword disrupts alien aberrant flesh and scores critical hits on an 19 or 20 against aberrations. Lustrous plum-colored byeshk metal is etched with goblinoid war honorifics.

items.Properties / Flavor: A dark canvas backpack packed with a crowbar, hammer, pitons, hooded lantern, oil, rations, and tinderbox. It provides specialized tools tailored for subterranean infiltration, lock bypass, and urban thievery.
items.Description & Mechanics: A dark canvas backpack packed with a crowbar, hammer, pitons, hooded lantern, oil, rations, and tinderbox. It provides specialized tools tailored for subterranean infiltration, lock bypass, and urban thievery.

items.Properties / Flavor: This golden peacock feather writes without ink and can animate simple illustrations on parchment for short theatrical demonstrations. The vibrant plume shifts color depending on the emotion behind the words.
items.Description & Mechanics: This golden peacock feather writes without ink and can animate simple illustrations on parchment for short theatrical demonstrations. The vibrant plume shifts color depending on the emotion behind the words.

items.Properties / Flavor: An intricately patterned Calishite silk carpet that hovers effortlessly in mid-air upon a command word. It carries multiple passengers across the skies at swift speeds, controlled entirely by thought.
items.Description & Mechanics: An intricately patterned Calishite silk carpet that hovers effortlessly in mid-air upon a command word. It carries multiple passengers across the skies at swift speeds, controlled entirely by thought.

items.Properties / Flavor: A lightweight wooden framework covered in waxed silk worn as a compact back harness. Unfurling the wings allows forest scouts to glide safely between giant canopy trees across forest valleys.
items.Description & Mechanics: A lightweight wooden framework covered in waxed silk worn as a compact back harness. Unfurling the wings allows forest scouts to glide safely between giant canopy trees across forest valleys.

items.Properties / Flavor: Theatrical garments tailored with bright silks, faux gems, and exaggerated flourishes. Actors and tricksters wear it on stage or to blend into carnival crowds during masquerades.
items.Description & Mechanics: Theatrical garments tailored with bright silks, faux gems, and exaggerated flourishes. Actors and tricksters wear it on stage or to blend into carnival crowds during masquerades.

items.Properties / Flavor: A specialized harness and saddle tailored for unusual mounts such as griffons, pegasi, or giant lizards. It incorporates security straps and wing-clearance channels for safe aerial or subterranean riding.
items.Description & Mechanics: A specialized harness and saddle tailored for unusual mounts such as griffons, pegasi, or giant lizards. It incorporates security straps and wing-clearance channels for safe aerial or subterranean riding.

items.Properties / Flavor: A tailored ensemble of black velvet robes and an unyielding faceless helm worn by Waterdeep's Masked Lords. It conceals your identity, vocal timbre, height, and thoughts from all physical and magical detection.
items.Description & Mechanics: A tailored ensemble of black velvet robes and an unyielding faceless helm worn by Waterdeep's Masked Lords. It conceals your identity, vocal timbre, height, and thoughts from all physical and magical detection.

items.Properties / Flavor: Soft leather slippers embroidered with swirling cloud motifs that lift your heels off the ground. They allow the wearer to dash as a bonus action and tread across water or mud without sinking.
items.Description & Mechanics: Soft leather slippers embroidered with swirling cloud motifs that lift your heels off the ground. They allow the wearer to dash as a bonus action and tread across water or mud without sinking.

items.Properties / Flavor: You ignore difficult terrain caused by loose sand, mud, or snow, leaving no physical tracks behind as you travel. Braided palm reeds and desert leather form these lightweight, comfortable slip-on sandals.
items.Description & Mechanics: You ignore difficult terrain caused by loose sand, mud, or snow, leaving no physical tracks behind as you travel. Braided palm reeds and desert leather form these lightweight, comfortable slip-on sandals.

items.Properties / Flavor: Crafted from supple brown leather reinforced with flexible iron spring plates along the soles. They ensure the wearer moves at full speed regardless of encumbrance and triple jump distances.
items.Description & Mechanics: Crafted from supple brown leather reinforced with flexible iron spring plates along the soles. They ensure the wearer moves at full speed regardless of encumbrance and triple jump distances.

items.Properties / Flavor: A hauberk of interlocking steel rings worn between layers of quilted linen to absorb incoming cuts. It shields the torso comfortably and can be discreetly worn beneath everyday noble clothing.
items.Description & Mechanics: A hauberk of interlocking steel rings worn between layers of quilted linen to absorb incoming cuts. It shields the torso comfortably and can be discreetly worn beneath everyday noble clothing.

items.Properties / Flavor: A polished blue sapphire suspended from a delicate platinum chain that warms against the chest. The wearer is completely immune to contracting any natural or magical disease.
items.Description & Mechanics: A polished blue sapphire suspended from a delicate platinum chain that warms against the chest. The wearer is completely immune to contracting any natural or magical disease.

items.Properties / Flavor: A tarnished bronze key whose teeth seem to constantly shift and realign when not observed. It has a five percent chance of unlocking any locked door it is inserted into before vanishing forever.
items.Description & Mechanics: A tarnished bronze key whose teeth seem to constantly shift and realign when not observed. It has a five percent chance of unlocking any locked door it is inserted into before vanishing forever.

items.Properties / Flavor: A heavy iron key sculpted with the hilt of a broadsword that hums with martial resolve. Inserting it into any locked portal opens a temporary gateway into an ancient extradimensional armory.
items.Description & Mechanics: A heavy iron key sculpted with the hilt of a broadsword that hums with martial resolve. Inserting it into any locked portal opens a temporary gateway into an ancient extradimensional armory.

items.Properties / Flavor: An exquisitely light hauberk woven from interlocking links of silvered elven mithral. Any character can wear this armor and gain its defensive benefits without possessing medium armor proficiency.
items.Description & Mechanics: An exquisitely light hauberk woven from interlocking links of silvered elven mithral. Any character can wear this armor and gain its defensive benefits without possessing medium armor proficiency.

items.Properties / Flavor: A key sculpted from shifting shadow-glass that alters its teeth to match any mechanical keyhole. It opens locks with advantage and allows the bearer to step through shadows behind locked doors.
items.Description & Mechanics: A key sculpted from shifting shadow-glass that alters its teeth to match any mechanical keyhole. It opens locks with advantage and allows the bearer to step through shadows behind locked doors.

items.Properties / Flavor: Heavy steel shoulder guards embossed with charging ram heads that lock into place during combat. They reduce incoming physical damage from frontal attacks and allow you to bull-rush opponents.
items.Description & Mechanics: Heavy steel shoulder guards embossed with charging ram heads that lock into place during combat. They reduce incoming physical damage from frontal attacks and allow you to bull-rush opponents.

items.Properties / Flavor: Thick iron vambraces reinforced with riveted dwarven plates that lock across the forearms. Bracing your arms together creates a temporary shield of force that absorbs heavy physical missile volleys.
items.Description & Mechanics: Thick iron vambraces reinforced with riveted dwarven plates that lock across the forearms. Bracing your arms together creates a temporary shield of force that absorbs heavy physical missile volleys.

items.Properties / Flavor: A hooded brass lantern that traps a peaceful, friendly spirit whose presence radiates soft emerald light. The spirit stabilizes dying companions within thirty feet and warns the party of nearby undead.
items.Description & Mechanics: A hooded brass lantern that traps a peaceful, friendly spirit whose presence radiates soft emerald light. The spirit stabilizes dying companions within thirty feet and warns the party of nearby undead.

items.Properties / Flavor: A sealed brass lantern that produces bright illumination without consuming oxygen or fuel. It provides reliable light inside airless vacuums and signals nearby spelljamming ships.
items.Description & Mechanics: A sealed brass lantern that produces bright illumination without consuming oxygen or fuel. It provides reliable light inside airless vacuums and signals nearby spelljamming ships.

items.Properties / Flavor: A clay flask containing one pint of refined lamp oil that burns cleanly for six hours in lamps. Splashing it across a creature and igniting it deals recurring fire damage for two rounds.
items.Description & Mechanics: A clay flask containing one pint of refined lamp oil that burns cleanly for six hours in lamps. Splashing it across a creature and igniting it deals recurring fire damage for two rounds.

items.Properties / Flavor: A sticky amber oil that burns hotter than ordinary lamp oil and cannot be extinguished by water. Hurling it coats targets in clinging chemical flames that burn until smothered.
items.Description & Mechanics: A sticky amber oil that burns hotter than ordinary lamp oil and cannot be extinguished by water. Hurling it coats targets in clinging chemical flames that burn until smothered.

items.Properties / Flavor: A translucent azure glass bead that dissolves immediately when dropped into water or placed on the tongue. It instantly quenches the user's thirst as if they had consumed a full pint of fresh water.
items.Description & Mechanics: A translucent azure glass bead that dissolves immediately when dropped into water or placed on the tongue. It instantly quenches the user's thirst as if they had consumed a full pint of fresh water.

items.Properties / Flavor: An exquisite frosted glass bottle containing sweet, intoxicating floral perfume crafted from fey essences. Applying it grants advantage on Charisma checks against humanoid creatures for one hour.
items.Description & Mechanics: An exquisite frosted glass bottle containing sweet, intoxicating floral perfume crafted from fey essences. Applying it grants advantage on Charisma checks against humanoid creatures for one hour.

items.Properties / Flavor: A heavy brass flask sealed with lead and stamped with fiery sultan seals. Unstopping the bottle releases a fierce efreeti who may grant wishes, fight as an ally, or attack in a vengeful rage.
items.Description & Mechanics: A heavy brass flask sealed with lead and stamped with fiery sultan seals. Unstopping the bottle releases a fierce efreeti who may grant wishes, fight as an ally, or attack in a vengeful rage.

items.Properties / Flavor: A tall framed glass mirror whose surface reflects misty corridors leading into extradimensional cells. Looking into the mirror can snare creatures inside one of twelve extradimensional prison chambers.
items.Description & Mechanics: A tall framed glass mirror whose surface reflects misty corridors leading into extradimensional cells. Looking into the mirror can snare creatures inside one of twelve extradimensional prison chambers.

items.Properties / Flavor: A thick, sticky secretion harvested from the tentacles of a subterranean carrion crawler. Making physical contact with the mucus paralyzes the victim completely for one minute.
items.Description & Mechanics: A thick, sticky secretion harvested from the tentacles of a subterranean carrion crawler. Making physical contact with the mucus paralyzes the victim completely for one minute.

items.Properties / Flavor: A fine mineral powder ground from toxic underworld minerals that blows into eyes and lungs. Inhaling the dust results in immediate, agonizing blindness that lasts for one hour.
items.Description & Mechanics: A fine mineral powder ground from toxic underworld minerals that blows into eyes and lungs. Inhaling the dust results in immediate, agonizing blindness that lasts for one hour.

items.Properties / Flavor: A silver hand mirror that reflects events that occurred in the room up to one century ago. Holding it reveals historical conversations, phantom footsteps, and clues left by previous occupants.
items.Description & Mechanics: A silver hand mirror that reflects events that occurred in the room up to one century ago. Holding it reveals historical conversations, phantom footsteps, and clues left by previous occupants.

items.Properties / Flavor: A glass phial filled with enchanted draconic blood that hangs from a braided gold chain. It grants a +2 bonus to sorcerer spell attack rolls and save DCs while restoring sorcery points during rests.
items.Description & Mechanics: A glass phial filled with enchanted draconic blood that hangs from a braided gold chain. It grants a +2 bonus to sorcerer spell attack rolls and save DCs while restoring sorcery points during rests.

items.Properties / Flavor: A faceted ruby phial pulsing with primordial arcane blood that crackles with raw metamagic power. It grants a +3 bonus to sorcerer spell DCs and attack rolls while replenishing five sorcery points.
items.Description & Mechanics: A faceted ruby phial pulsing with primordial arcane blood that crackles with raw metamagic power. It grants a +3 bonus to sorcerer spell DCs and attack rolls while replenishing five sorcery points.

items.Properties / Flavor: A sparkling glass phial filled with shimmering multicolored fairy dust that floats upward when uncorked. Sprinkling it across a creature grants them a flying speed of thirty feet for one minute.
items.Description & Mechanics: A sparkling glass phial filled with shimmering multicolored fairy dust that floats upward when uncorked. Sprinkling it across a creature grants them a flying speed of thirty feet for one minute.

items.Properties / Flavor: A sealed glass bottle containing a swirling cluster of genuine miniature constellations. Releasing a star illuminates entire cavern complexes with soft starlight or discharges a radiant nova in battle.
items.Description & Mechanics: A sealed glass bottle containing a swirling cluster of genuine miniature constellations. Releasing a star illuminates entire cavern complexes with soft starlight or discharges a radiant nova in battle.

items.Properties / Flavor: A hand mirror of polished silver that reflects the silvery voids and floating islands of the Astral Plane. Touching the glass allows you to project an illusory astral double to confuse attackers.
items.Description & Mechanics: A hand mirror of polished silver that reflects the silvery voids and floating islands of the Astral Plane. Touching the glass allows you to project an illusory astral double to confuse attackers.

items.Properties / Flavor: A glass flask filled with pressurized alchemical naphtha and white phosphor that ignites on air contact. It blankets a fifteen-foot area in clinging liquid flames that burn continuously.
items.Description & Mechanics: A glass flask filled with pressurized alchemical naphtha and white phosphor that ignites on air contact. It blankets a fifteen-foot area in clinging liquid flames that burn continuously.

items.Properties / Flavor: Uncorking this glass vessel releases an illusion of a full-rigged warship that sails on command or stores cargo inside an extradimensional hold. A perfectly detailed miniature schooner bobs on real sea brine within.
items.Description & Mechanics: Uncorking this glass vessel releases an illusion of a full-rigged warship that sails on command or stores cargo inside an extradimensional hold. A perfectly detailed miniature schooner bobs on real sea brine within.

items.Properties / Flavor: Looking into this silver-framed hand mirror lets you cast mirror image at will and major image twice per dawn. Polished obsidian glass reflects whimsical faerie lights that dance behind the viewer's reflection.
items.Description & Mechanics: Looking into this silver-framed hand mirror lets you cast mirror image at will and major image twice per dawn. Polished obsidian glass reflects whimsical faerie lights that dance behind the viewer's reflection.

items.Properties / Flavor: Coating firearm ammunition in this consecrated ash doubles the damage dice of your next ranged firearm attack. A bone vial holds powdered marrow harvested from sanctified martyrs and preserved in holy oil.
items.Description & Mechanics: Coating firearm ammunition in this consecrated ash doubles the damage dice of your next ranged firearm attack. A bone vial holds powdered marrow harvested from sanctified martyrs and preserved in holy oil.

items.Properties / Flavor: Drinking this thick herbal draft immediately cures the frightened condition and halts encroaching psychological madness. Bitter milky fluid is stoppered in a thick medicinal glass bottle with an amber wax seal.
items.Description & Mechanics: Drinking this thick herbal draft immediately cures the frightened condition and halts encroaching psychological madness. Bitter milky fluid is stoppered in a thick medicinal glass bottle with an amber wax seal.

items.Properties / Flavor: This graduated brass flask automatically mixes and measures alchemical reagents to brew simple potions twice as fast. Miniature dials and measuring gauges line the heat-resistant crystal beaker.
items.Description & Mechanics: This graduated brass flask automatically mixes and measures alchemical reagents to brew simple potions twice as fast. Miniature dials and measuring gauges line the heat-resistant crystal beaker.

items.Properties / Flavor: Drinking this airy vapor lets you walk on clouds and fog banks as if they were solid ground for one hour. Swirling white mist is trapped inside a rounded glass flask that feels weightless in hand.
items.Description & Mechanics: Drinking this airy vapor lets you walk on clouds and fog banks as if they were solid ground for one hour. Swirling white mist is trapped inside a rounded glass flask that feels weightless in hand.

items.Properties / Flavor: A small wooden raven talisman carved from sacred rowan wood that trembles before imminent misfortune. It alerts the owner to nearby ambushes and allows the reroll of one critical saving throw daily.
items.Description & Mechanics: A small wooden raven talisman carved from sacred rowan wood that trembles before imminent misfortune. It alerts the owner to nearby ambushes and allows the reroll of one critical saving throw daily.

items.Properties / Flavor: A sharpened ash wood stake chased with spiraling alchemical silver wire along its point. Driving it into the heart of an incapacitated vampire paralyzes the monster permanently.
items.Description & Mechanics: A sharpened ash wood stake chased with spiraling alchemical silver wire along its point. Driving it into the heart of an incapacitated vampire paralyzes the monster permanently.

items.Properties / Flavor: Wearing these raised wooden sandals allows you to walk across wet mud or river shallows without soaking your feet or slipping. Polished paulownia wood is elevated on sturdy wooden teeth and fastened with red fabric thongs.
items.Description & Mechanics: Wearing these raised wooden sandals allows you to walk across wet mud or river shallows without soaking your feet or slipping. Polished paulownia wood is elevated on sturdy wooden teeth and fastened with red fabric thongs.

items.Properties / Flavor: A slender baton carved from lightweight pearwood that feels balanced for musical conducting. Waving it in the air produces orchestral melodies and choral notes that carry across three hundred feet.
items.Description & Mechanics: A slender baton carved from lightweight pearwood that feels balanced for musical conducting. Waving it in the air produces orchestral melodies and choral notes that carry across three hundred feet.

items.Properties / Flavor: A miniature wooden wardrobe charm hung upon a silver link chain around the neck. Whispering a command instantly changes your clothing and gear into another stored outfit suited for social deception.
items.Description & Mechanics: A miniature wooden wardrobe charm hung upon a silver link chain around the neck. Whispering a command instantly changes your clothing and gear into another stored outfit suited for social deception.

items.Properties / Flavor: Brass-rimmed leather goggles fitted with multiple adjustable magnifying lenses and tiny steam exhausts. They grant sharp vision through obscure smoke and provide microscopic magnification for delicate tinkering.
items.Description & Mechanics: Brass-rimmed leather goggles fitted with multiple adjustable magnifying lenses and tiny steam exhausts. They grant sharp vision through obscure smoke and provide microscopic magnification for delicate tinkering.

items.Properties / Flavor: A complex brass screwdriver mechanism with shifting gears that transforms into any artisan tool. It increases artificer spell attack rolls and DCs, and grants temporary cantrip knowledge.
items.Description & Mechanics: A complex brass screwdriver mechanism with shifting gears that transforms into any artisan tool. It increases artificer spell attack rolls and DCs, and grants temporary cantrip knowledge.

items.Properties / Flavor: A precision brass multi-tool mechanism that smoothly transforms into any artisan tool you imagine. It provides a +2 bonus to artificer spell attack rolls and DCs while granting cantrip mastery.
items.Description & Mechanics: A precision brass multi-tool mechanism that smoothly transforms into any artisan tool you imagine. It provides a +2 bonus to artificer spell attack rolls and DCs while granting cantrip mastery.

items.Description & Mechanics: A massive iron kettle that simmers with nourishing beef and vegetable stew without requiring fire or meat. It produces enough hearty food daily to feed up to one hundred starving townsfolk.

items.Properties / Flavor: Harvested from the digestive sacs of giant subterranean grubs and sealed in reinforced ceramic jars. Splashing it across armor corrodes structural iron and inflicts lingering acid burns.
