items.Properties / Flavor: A hooded cloak woven from shadowfell threads that billows with faint ribbons of twilight darkness. It grants advantage on stealth checks and allows the wearer to turn invisible as an action in dim light.
items.Description & Mechanics: A hooded cloak woven from shadowfell threads that billows with faint ribbons of twilight darkness. It grants advantage on stealth checks and allows the wearer to turn invisible as an action in dim light.

items.Properties / Flavor: Wearing this funerary mask grants resistance to necrotic damage and allows communication with positive undead ancestors. Carved from pale fossilized livewood, it depicts serene, immortal elven features adorned with platinum leaf.
items.Description & Mechanics: Wearing this funerary mask grants resistance to necrotic damage and allows communication with positive undead ancestors. Carved from pale fossilized livewood, it depicts serene, immortal elven features adorned with platinum leaf.

items.Properties / Flavor: Wearing this mask gives you advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks relying on sight out to one mile. Hammered gold sheet is shaped into the regal face of a falcon with painted lapis lazuli eye rings.
items.Description & Mechanics: Wearing this mask gives you advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks relying on sight out to one mile. Hammered gold sheet is shaped into the regal face of a falcon with painted lapis lazuli eye rings.

items.Properties / Flavor: Wearing this carved mask lets you speak with plants and animals and cast pass without trace once per long rest. Pale cypress wood is hand-carved with benevolent woodland spirit features crowned with dried lichen.
items.Description & Mechanics: Wearing this carved mask lets you speak with plants and animals and cast pass without trace once per long rest. Pale cypress wood is hand-carved with benevolent woodland spirit features crowned with dried lichen.

items.Properties / Flavor: A stylish cloak woven from adaptive enchanted thread that shifts appearance at a mere thought. The wearer can alter its color, pattern, cut, and perceived fabric quality to blend into any crowd.
items.Description & Mechanics: A stylish cloak woven from adaptive enchanted thread that shifts appearance at a mere thought. The wearer can alter its color, pattern, cut, and perceived fabric quality to blend into any crowd.

items.Properties / Flavor: Rough linen hand wraps inscribed with boxing prayers and soaked in hardened mineral salts. They turn unarmed strikes into lethal magical weapons and grant temporary stamina when hitting foes.
items.Description & Mechanics: Rough linen hand wraps inscribed with boxing prayers and soaked in hardened mineral salts. They turn unarmed strikes into lethal magical weapons and grant temporary stamina when hitting foes.

items.Properties / Flavor: A wooden palette, assorted badger-hair brushes, mixing oils, natural pigments, and stretched linen canvas. It enables artists to paint portraits, sketch architectural maps, and create camouflage banners.
items.Description & Mechanics: A wooden palette, assorted badger-hair brushes, mixing oils, natural pigments, and stretched linen canvas. It enables artists to paint portraits, sketch architectural maps, and create camouflage banners.

items.Properties / Flavor: A deck of fifty-four painted linen cards depicting monarchs, knights, and seasonal astrological suits. It provides entertainment around campfires and allows rogues to practice sleight of hand tricks.
items.Description & Mechanics: A deck of fifty-four painted linen cards depicting monarchs, knights, and seasonal astrological suits. It provides entertainment around campfires and allows rogues to practice sleight of hand tricks.

items.Properties / Flavor: A miniature silver box containing a tiny sacred holy relic such as bone ash or robe thread. Clerics clutch it in their hands to invoke Channel Divinity and manifest miracles.
items.Description & Mechanics: A miniature silver box containing a tiny sacred holy relic such as bone ash or robe thread. Clerics clutch it in their hands to invoke Channel Divinity and manifest miracles.

items.Properties / Flavor: Spinning thread upon this enchanted handloom allows the user to cast sleep at 4th level or send illusory dream messages across planes. Intricate silver spools hold ethereal thread spun from fallen starlight.
items.Description & Mechanics: Spinning thread upon this enchanted handloom allows the user to cast sleep at 4th level or send illusory dream messages across planes. Intricate silver spools hold ethereal thread spun from fallen starlight.

items.Properties / Flavor: A green tallow candle that burns with an eerie emerald flame that cannot be snuffed by water. It provides illumination even when submerged under high ocean pressures in underwater trenches.
items.Description & Mechanics: A green tallow candle that burns with an eerie emerald flame that cannot be snuffed by water. It provides illumination even when submerged under high ocean pressures in underwater trenches.

items.Properties / Flavor: A sacred tallow candle dedicated to a specific alignment that burns with divine radiance for four hours. While lit, it empowers cleric and druid spells and can summon an avatar to cast gate.
items.Description & Mechanics: A sacred tallow candle dedicated to a specific alignment that burns with divine radiance for four hours. While lit, it empowers cleric and druid spells and can summon an avatar to cast gate.

items.Properties / Flavor: A matched ritual set of a silver handbell, an illuminated prayer book, and a beeswax candle. Performing the tripartite ritual dispels regional curses, banishes possessing spirits, and sanctifies graves.
items.Description & Mechanics: A matched ritual set of a silver handbell, an illuminated prayer book, and a beeswax candle. Performing the tripartite ritual dispels regional curses, banishes possessing spirits, and sanctifies graves.

items.Properties / Flavor: A slender taper molded from bee or tallow wax around a braided cotton wick. It burns for one hour, shedding bright light in a five-foot radius and dim light for five feet.
items.Description & Mechanics: A slender taper molded from bee or tallow wax around a braided cotton wick. It burns for one hour, shedding bright light in a five-foot radius and dim light for five feet.

items.Properties / Flavor: A twisted pink beeswax candle scented with honeysuckle that burns with a soft lavender flame. Its light reveals hidden fey creatures, dispels fairy illusions, and grants sweet dreams to nearby sleepers.
items.Description & Mechanics: A twisted pink beeswax candle scented with honeysuckle that burns with a soft lavender flame. Its light reveals hidden fey creatures, dispels fairy illusions, and grants sweet dreams to nearby sleepers.

items.Properties / Flavor: A phosphor-coated glass monocle held in a brass frame that amplifies ambient nocturnal light. It grants sixty feet of green-tinted darkvision without revealing the wearer's position.
items.Description & Mechanics: A phosphor-coated glass monocle held in a brass frame that amplifies ambient nocturnal light. It grants sixty feet of green-tinted darkvision without revealing the wearer's position.

items.Properties / Flavor: When lit, this black wax candle consumes nonmagical flames within thirty feet and darkens bright light to dim light for one hour. The wick burns with a chilly violet ember that gives off no heat or smoke.
items.Description & Mechanics: When lit, this black wax candle consumes nonmagical flames within thirty feet and darkens bright light to dim light for one hour. The wick burns with a chilly violet ember that gives off no heat or smoke.

items.Properties / Flavor: This rune brand enhances your firearm attack range by fifty percent and reveals hidden enemy weak points. An abstract eye motif pulses with faint cerulean light upon the wielder's firearm grip or forearm.
items.Description & Mechanics: This rune brand enhances your firearm attack range by fifty percent and reveals hidden enemy weak points. An abstract eye motif pulses with faint cerulean light upon the wielder's firearm grip or forearm.

items.Properties / Flavor: Includes glass beakers, a copper retort, measuring scales, and various stabilizing powders for chemical synthesis. It permits practitioners to distill volatile extracts, acids, and smoke concoctions.
items.Description & Mechanics: Includes glass beakers, a copper retort, measuring scales, and various stabilizing powders for chemical synthesis. It permits practitioners to distill volatile extracts, acids, and smoke concoctions.

items.Properties / Flavor: A convex polished glass lens mounted inside a brass ring with a carved rosewood handle. It grants detailed examination of minute clues, runes, and gemstones, or focuses sunlight into flame.
items.Description & Mechanics: A convex polished glass lens mounted inside a brass ring with a carved rosewood handle. It grants detailed examination of minute clues, runes, and gemstones, or focuses sunlight into flame.

items.Properties / Flavor: An ornate ceramic jug carved with ocean waves and fitted with a lead stopper. Speaking command words causes it to pour endless fresh water in gentle streams, fountains, or geysers.
items.Description & Mechanics: An ornate ceramic jug carved with ocean waves and fitted with a lead stopper. Speaking command words causes it to pour endless fresh water in gentle streams, fountains, or geysers.

items.Properties / Flavor: Delicate wire spectacles fitted with multi-layered crystal lenses that rotate into place. They magnify tiny details up to thirty times, granting advantage on investigation checks within one foot.
items.Description & Mechanics: Delicate wire spectacles fitted with multi-layered crystal lenses that rotate into place. They magnify tiny details up to thirty times, granting advantage on investigation checks within one foot.

items.Properties / Flavor: Curved crystal spectacles set into a golden frame chased with soaring raptor feathers. They grant advantage on visual perception checks and allow clear sight across vast horizons.
items.Description & Mechanics: Curved crystal spectacles set into a golden frame chased with soaring raptor feathers. They grant advantage on visual perception checks and allow clear sight across vast horizons.

items.Properties / Flavor: A teardrop-shaped violet psionic crystal that dissolves into mental focus when held against the temple. It allows a spellcaster to apply the Subtle Spell metamagic to one spell without expending sorcery points.
items.Description & Mechanics: A teardrop-shaped violet psionic crystal that dissolves into mental focus when held against the temple. It allows a spellcaster to apply the Subtle Spell metamagic to one spell without expending sorcery points.

items.Properties / Flavor: A jagged amethyst crystal that vibrates with hyper-accelerated psionic thought waves. Crushing it allows you to cast a spell with a casting time of one action as a bonus action instead.
items.Description & Mechanics: A jagged amethyst crystal that vibrates with hyper-accelerated psionic thought waves. Crushing it allows you to cast a spell with a casting time of one action as a bonus action instead.

items.Properties / Flavor: A glowing ruby psionic crystal that radiates aggressive telepathic resonance. When you roll damage for a spell, crushing the crystal allows you to re-roll up to three damage dice.
items.Description & Mechanics: A glowing ruby psionic crystal that radiates aggressive telepathic resonance. When you roll damage for a spell, crushing the crystal allows you to re-roll up to three damage dice.

items.Properties / Flavor: A smooth sapphire crystal that projects a calm, calculated mental aura when held. Using it protects chosen allies from suffering full damage from an area-of-effect spell you cast.
items.Description & Mechanics: A smooth sapphire crystal that projects a calm, calculated mental aura when held. Using it protects chosen allies from suffering full damage from an area-of-effect spell you cast.

items.Properties / Flavor: A topaz crystal that hums with enduring temporal energy when attuned to your mind. Channeling its power doubles the duration of your next concentration spell up to twenty-four hours.
items.Description & Mechanics: A topaz crystal that hums with enduring temporal energy when attuned to your mind. Channeling its power doubles the duration of your next concentration spell up to twenty-four hours.

items.Properties / Flavor: A tiny mechanical eyeball fitted with brass crawling legs and an adjustable crystal lens. It scuttles beneath closed doorways to transmit audio and visual scouting feedback to its operator.
items.Description & Mechanics: A tiny mechanical eyeball fitted with brass crawling legs and an adjustable crystal lens. It scuttles beneath closed doorways to transmit audio and visual scouting feedback to its operator.

items.Properties / Flavor: Bulbous brass goggles fitted with amber crystal lenses that detect infrared thermal heat signatures. They reveal living warm-blooded creatures through dense smoke, magical fog, and total darkness.
items.Description & Mechanics: Bulbous brass goggles fitted with amber crystal lenses that detect infrared thermal heat signatures. They reveal living warm-blooded creatures through dense smoke, magical fog, and total darkness.

items.Properties / Flavor: A blackened steel crossbow fitted with an integrated shadow-lens sight and silenced prod. Bolts loosed from the weapon produce no audible sound and deal bonus necrotic damage from darkness.
items.Description & Mechanics: A blackened steel crossbow fitted with an integrated shadow-lens sight and silenced prod. Bolts loosed from the weapon produce no audible sound and deal bonus necrotic damage from darkness.

items.Properties / Flavor: When swung under daylight, this +1 curved sword refracts sunlight into dazzling flashes that can blind opponents on a critical strike. The blade is ground from crystalline quartz that sparkles with rainbow spectrums.
items.Description & Mechanics: When swung under daylight, this +1 curved sword refracts sunlight into dazzling flashes that can blind opponents on a critical strike. The blade is ground from crystalline quartz that sparkles with rainbow spectrums.

items.Properties / Flavor: Consulting the astrological dials of this pocket instrument allows you to cast augury without expending spell slots twice per day. Rotating golden gears and astrological sign markers are protected under domed crystal lens.
items.Description & Mechanics: Consulting the astrological dials of this pocket instrument allows you to cast augury without expending spell slots twice per day. Rotating golden gears and astrological sign markers are protected under domed crystal lens.

items.Properties / Flavor: A perforated copper vessel suspended on three chains designed to burn aromatic incense. Lighting incense inside summons an air elemental that swirls around you to shield against missile attacks.
items.Description & Mechanics: A perforated copper vessel suspended on three chains designed to burn aromatic incense. Lighting incense inside summons an air elemental that swirls around you to shield against missile attacks.

items.Properties / Flavor: A warhammer crafted from solid solar-forged brass that glows with the burning righteous wrath of the Boros Legion. The wielder can hurl the hammer to unleash an explosive blast of fire before it magically returns to hand.
items.Description & Mechanics: A warhammer crafted from solid solar-forged brass that glows with the burning righteous wrath of the Boros Legion. The wielder can hurl the hammer to unleash an explosive blast of fire before it magically returns to hand.

items.Properties / Flavor: A heavy portable brass mortar cannon engineered by the Izzet League to launch volatile mizzium payloads. It fires concussive explosive fire shells that blast barricades or sprays molten metal over sweeping arcs.
items.Description & Mechanics: A heavy portable brass mortar cannon engineered by the Izzet League to launch volatile mizzium payloads. It fires concussive explosive fire shells that blast barricades or sprays molten metal over sweeping arcs.

items.Properties / Flavor: A backpack brass contraption of bubbling retorts, coiled copper tubing, and glass gauges. It allows a spellcaster to attempt casting spells they haven't prepared by channeling chaotic arcane energy.
items.Description & Mechanics: A backpack brass contraption of bubbling retorts, coiled copper tubing, and glass gauges. It allows a spellcaster to attempt casting spells they haven't prepared by channeling chaotic arcane energy.

items.Properties / Flavor: A brass flamethrower handset linked to an alchemical fuel reservoir worn at the hip. It projects a ten-foot cone of searing fire, though consecutive bursts risk backfiring in an explosion.
items.Description & Mechanics: A brass flamethrower handset linked to an alchemical fuel reservoir worn at the hip. It projects a ten-foot cone of searing fire, though consecutive bursts risk backfiring in an explosion.

items.Properties / Flavor: Three wooden pipes bound with tarnished wire that smell faintly of river damp and copper. Playing them summons swarms of rats from nearby sewers that obey your telepathic commands.
items.Description & Mechanics: Three wooden pipes bound with tarnished wire that smell faintly of river damp and copper. Playing them summons swarms of rats from nearby sewers that obey your telepathic commands.

items.Properties / Flavor: An ordinary-looking wooden walking cane fitted with a polished brass ferrule. Speaking a command word transforms the cane instantly into an ordinary steel longsword.
items.Description & Mechanics: An ordinary-looking wooden walking cane fitted with a polished brass ferrule. Speaking a command word transforms the cane instantly into an ordinary steel longsword.

items.Properties / Flavor: Heavy steel masonry chisels, stone hammers, trowels, plumb bobs, and measuring chalk lines in a bag. It permits stonemasons to carve stone blocks, identify architectural weaknesses, and bypass walls.
items.Description & Mechanics: Heavy steel masonry chisels, stone hammers, trowels, plumb bobs, and measuring chalk lines in a bag. It permits stonemasons to carve stone blocks, identify architectural weaknesses, and bypass walls.

items.Properties / Flavor: A short-barreled blackpowder gun featuring a flared brass muzzle designed to spray lead shot across wide arcs. It delivers devastating spread damage against grouped enemies at close range.
items.Description & Mechanics: A short-barreled blackpowder gun featuring a flared brass muzzle designed to spray lead shot across wide arcs. It delivers devastating spread damage against grouped enemies at close range.

items.Properties / Flavor: Firing this short-barreled scattergun deals 2d8 piercing damage in a fifteen-foot cone to unbalance charging monstrosities. Flared brass muzzle bell is strapped to a scorched walnut stock with steel banding.
items.Description & Mechanics: Firing this short-barreled scattergun deals 2d8 piercing damage in a fifteen-foot cone to unbalance charging monstrosities. Flared brass muzzle bell is strapped to a scorched walnut stock with steel banding.

items.Properties / Flavor: A leather roll containing ten uses of sterilized bandages, herbal balms, tourniquets, and splints. Applying its contents stabilizes a dying companion without requiring magical healing.
items.Description & Mechanics: A leather roll containing ten uses of sterilized bandages, herbal balms, tourniquets, and splints. Applying its contents stabilizes a dying companion without requiring magical healing.

items.Properties / Flavor: A greasy brown salve distilled from pungent swamp roots that is rubbed liberally over exposed skin. A single application repels biting flies and prevents jungle parasites for twenty-four hours.
items.Description & Mechanics: A greasy brown salve distilled from pungent swamp roots that is rubbed liberally over exposed skin. A single application repels biting flies and prevents jungle parasites for twenty-four hours.

items.Properties / Flavor: A pungent green unguent concocted from purified troll marrow and regenerative alchemical herbs. Rubbing it over wounds restores ten hit points every round for one minute and regenerates severed fingers.
items.Description & Mechanics: A pungent green unguent concocted from purified troll marrow and regenerative alchemical herbs. Rubbing it over wounds restores ten hit points every round for one minute and regenerates severed fingers.

items.Properties / Flavor: A curved war scythe forged from blackened tomb iron that radiates freezing necrotic chill. Striking a living creature reaps their vital essence, healing the wielder for half the damage dealt.
items.Description & Mechanics: A curved war scythe forged from blackened tomb iron that radiates freezing necrotic chill. Striking a living creature reaps their vital essence, healing the wielder for half the damage dealt.

items.Properties / Flavor: Shattering this frozen shard encases an enemy within twenty feet in freezing rime that reduces speed to zero on a failed save. Blue glacial ice harvested from the Plain of Ice never melts under mundane summer temperatures.
items.Description & Mechanics: Shattering this frozen shard encases an enemy within twenty feet in freezing rime that reduces speed to zero on a failed save. Blue glacial ice harvested from the Plain of Ice never melts under mundane summer temperatures.

items.Properties / Flavor: A spiral brass horn chased with lightning motifs and destructive thunder runes. Sounding it releases a concussive cone of thunder damage, though it risks catastrophic backfire.
items.Description & Mechanics: A spiral brass horn chased with lightning motifs and destructive thunder runes. Sounding it releases a concussive cone of thunder damage, though it risks catastrophic backfire.

items.Properties / Flavor: A polished goat horn wrapped in silver wire that produces no sound detectable by ordinary human ears. When blown, its silent warning can only be heard by one designated creature within six hundred feet.
items.Description & Mechanics: A polished goat horn wrapped in silver wire that produces no sound detectable by ordinary human ears. When blown, its silent warning can only be heard by one designated creature within six hundred feet.

items.Properties / Flavor: A finely lacquered lute inlaid with mother-of-pearl accents that resonate with minor sensory magic. Playing the instrument creates harmless, shifting visual illusions that dance around the performer.
items.Description & Mechanics: A finely lacquered lute inlaid with mother-of-pearl accents that resonate with minor sensory magic. Playing the instrument creates harmless, shifting visual illusions that dance around the performer.

items.Properties / Flavor: A curved brass war horn inscribed with northern warrior runes that roars like thunder. Sounding it summons spectral berserkers from Ysgard to overrun opposing forces for one hour.
items.Description & Mechanics: A curved brass war horn inscribed with northern warrior runes that roars like thunder. Sounding it summons spectral berserkers from Ysgard to overrun opposing forces for one hour.

items.Properties / Flavor: A carved minotaur horn chased with intricate subterranean labyrinth paths along its length. Sounding it disorients enemies within thirty feet, stripping them of direction and spatial memory.
items.Description & Mechanics: A carved minotaur horn chased with intricate subterranean labyrinth paths along its length. Sounding it disorients enemies within thirty feet, stripping them of direction and spatial memory.

items.Properties / Flavor: A handheld leather drum painted with vibrant musical runes that resonates with harmonic inspiration. It provides a +2 bonus to bard spell save DCs and attack rolls while replenishing a Bardic Inspiration die.
items.Description & Mechanics: A handheld leather drum painted with vibrant musical runes that resonates with harmonic inspiration. It provides a +2 bonus to bard spell save DCs and attack rolls while replenishing a Bardic Inspiration die.

items.Properties / Flavor: A curved brass instrument that flares into a wide bell capable of projecting deep, resonant calls. Watch officers and heralds sound it to announce royal arrivals or sound city-wide alarms.
items.Description & Mechanics: A curved brass instrument that flares into a wide bell capable of projecting deep, resonant calls. Watch officers and heralds sound it to announce royal arrivals or sound city-wide alarms.

items.Properties / Flavor: Winding this curved horn emits a terrifying sonic howl that forces creatures in a thirty-foot cone to succeed on a Wisdom save or become frightened. Polished ram horn is reinforced with banded iron and runic wolf engravings.
items.Description & Mechanics: Winding this curved horn emits a terrifying sonic howl that forces creatures in a thirty-foot cone to succeed on a Wisdom save or become frightened. Polished ram horn is reinforced with banded iron and runic wolf engravings.

items.Properties / Flavor: Blowing this heavy horn grants all allies within sixty feet advantage on saving throws against fear and 10 temporary hit points. Plated in crude iron bands, the horn bears battle trophies and scratched goblinoid war runes.
items.Description & Mechanics: Blowing this heavy horn grants all allies within sixty feet advantage on saving throws against fear and 10 temporary hit points. Plated in crude iron bands, the horn bears battle trophies and scratched goblinoid war runes.

items.Properties / Flavor: Beating this tribal hand drum preserves oral histories and lets the drummer cast heroism on up to three allies once per rest. Taut dire wolf hide is stretched over a hollowed ironwood frame carved with clan lineage pictographs.
items.Description & Mechanics: Beating this tribal hand drum preserves oral histories and lets the drummer cast heroism on up to three allies once per rest. Taut dire wolf hide is stretched over a hollowed ironwood frame carved with clan lineage pictographs.

items.Properties / Flavor: Sounding this brass war horn dispels magical silence and grants allies within thirty feet advantage on attack rolls for one round. Thick brass horn bells are hammered with martial goblin crests and wrapped in weathered leather.
items.Description & Mechanics: Sounding this brass war horn dispels magical silence and grants allies within thirty feet advantage on attack rolls for one round. Thick brass horn bells are hammered with martial goblin crests and wrapped in weathered leather.

items.Properties / Flavor: A spherical stone globe measuring one foot across that sits embedded into pedestals in public plazas. Stepping within five feet cleanses dirt, mud, and stains from clothing and armor instantly.
items.Description & Mechanics: A spherical stone globe measuring one foot across that sits embedded into pedestals in public plazas. Stepping within five feet cleanses dirt, mud, and stains from clothing and armor instantly.

items.Properties / Flavor: Fine clothing woven with iridescent threads that shimmer with subtle sensory illusions. It shifts colors to complement your mood and grants advantage on performance checks in high society.
items.Description & Mechanics: Fine clothing woven with iridescent threads that shimmer with subtle sensory illusions. It shifts colors to complement your mood and grants advantage on performance checks in high society.

items.Properties / Flavor: A fine suit of tailored clothing that magically repairs tears, rips, and frayed seams automatically. Leaving it undisturbed for one minute restores the garments to pristine tailored condition.
items.Description & Mechanics: A fine suit of tailored clothing that magically repairs tears, rips, and frayed seams automatically. Leaving it undisturbed for one minute restores the garments to pristine tailored condition.

items.Properties / Flavor: A tall black felt top hat that twitches and rustles faintly inside its satin crown. Reaching into the hat allows the bearer to pull out a live bat, rat, or frog three times daily.
items.Description & Mechanics: A tall black felt top hat that twitches and rustles faintly inside its satin crown. Reaching into the hat allows the bearer to pull out a live bat, rat, or frog three times daily.

items.Properties / Flavor: Simple utilitarian garments including a linen shirt, wool breeches, and a sturdy belt. It represents standard workaday clothing worn by peasants, farmers, and artisans across the city.
items.Description & Mechanics: Simple utilitarian garments including a linen shirt, wool breeches, and a sturdy belt. It represents standard workaday clothing worn by peasants, farmers, and artisans across the city.

items.Properties / Flavor: Durable woolen trousers, a belted tunic, leather boots, and a hooded cloaking mantle. It provides weather-resistant comfort and warmth for long overland treks along dusty trade roads.
items.Description & Mechanics: Durable woolen trousers, a belted tunic, leather boots, and a hooded cloaking mantle. It provides weather-resistant comfort and warmth for long overland treks along dusty trade roads.

items.Properties / Flavor: A carved ivory feather that expands into a full-sized wooden swan boat when placed into water. It glides across lakes and rivers with swift magical propulsion, carrying up to thirty passengers.
items.Description & Mechanics: A carved ivory feather that expands into a full-sized wooden swan boat when placed into water. It glides across lakes and rivers with swift magical propulsion, carrying up to thirty passengers.

items.Properties / Flavor: An enclosed passenger coach equipped with cushioned interior bench seating and leaf-spring suspension. It transports noble dignitaries through city avenues in refined aristocratic comfort.
items.Description & Mechanics: An enclosed passenger coach equipped with cushioned interior bench seating and leaf-spring suspension. It transports noble dignitaries through city avenues in refined aristocratic comfort.

items.Properties / Flavor: A light, fast two-wheeled war vehicle designed to carry an archer and driver at high galloping speeds. It circles enemy formations with swift flanking mobility during pitched plains warfare.
items.Description & Mechanics: A light, fast two-wheeled war vehicle designed to carry an archer and driver at high galloping speeds. It circles enemy formations with swift flanking mobility during pitched plains warfare.

items.Properties / Flavor: A graceful, flexible dragon-prowed war vessel engineered by northern raiders for ocean voyages and beach landings. Its shallow draft allows it to sail directly onto sandy shores for rapid infantry disembarkation.
items.Description & Mechanics: A graceful, flexible dragon-prowed war vessel engineered by northern raiders for ocean voyages and beach landings. Its shallow draft allows it to sail directly onto sandy shores for rapid infantry disembarkation.

items.Properties / Flavor: Sleek boots dyed bright crimson, fitted with silver winged buckles at each heel. Clicking the heels together doubles your walking speed and forces disadvantage on enemy opportunity attacks.
items.Description & Mechanics: Sleek boots dyed bright crimson, fitted with silver winged buckles at each heel. Clicking the heels together doubles your walking speed and forces disadvantage on enemy opportunity attacks.

items.Properties / Flavor: Heavy leather marching boots fitted with enchanted, shifting soles that reshape during steps. The wearer leaves behind the footprints of any humanoid creature of their choice to mislead trackers.
items.Description & Mechanics: Heavy leather marching boots fitted with enchanted, shifting soles that reshape during steps. The wearer leaves behind the footprints of any humanoid creature of their choice to mislead trackers.

items.Properties / Flavor: Supple leather boots crafted from the hide of a desert bulette that glide across loose sands. The wearer moves across mud, sand, and loose gravel at full speed without leaving any tracks.
items.Description & Mechanics: Supple leather boots crafted from the hide of a desert bulette that glide across loose sands. The wearer moves across mud, sand, and loose gravel at full speed without leaving any tracks.

items.Properties / Flavor: High riding boots crafted from soft dove-colored leather that barely touch the ground when walking. They allow the wearer to cast levitate on themselves at will to float twenty feet in the air.
items.Description & Mechanics: High riding boots crafted from soft dove-colored leather that barely touch the ground when walking. They allow the wearer to cast levitate on themselves at will to float twenty feet in the air.

items.Properties / Flavor: Soft leather boots adorned with downy white goose feathers embroidered along the ankles. When falling from great heights, they slow your descent rate so that you land gently on your feet.
items.Description & Mechanics: Soft leather boots adorned with downy white goose feathers embroidered along the ankles. When falling from great heights, they slow your descent rate so that you land gently on your feet.

items.Properties / Flavor: Winged boots crafted from azure leather that lift the wearer slightly above rough terrain. They grant an effortless twenty-foot hover speed and allow dashing as a bonus action across water.
items.Description & Mechanics: Winged boots crafted from azure leather that lift the wearer slightly above rough terrain. They grant an effortless twenty-foot hover speed and allow dashing as a bonus action across water.

items.Properties / Flavor: While wearing these supple leather boots, your jumping distance is tripled and you take no damage from falls under thirty feet. White fur trims the cuffs alongside brass buckles shaped like sprinting hares.
items.Description & Mechanics: While wearing these supple leather boots, your jumping distance is tripled and you take no damage from falls under thirty feet. White fur trims the cuffs alongside brass buckles shaped like sprinting hares.

items.Properties / Flavor: Stomping your heel into the ground casts earth tremor at 2nd level to shake footing and unbalance surrounding adversaries. Thick granite soles are riveted to rugged ox-hide boots reinforced with heavy iron toes.
items.Description & Mechanics: Stomping your heel into the ground casts earth tremor at 2nd level to shake footing and unbalance surrounding adversaries. Thick granite soles are riveted to rugged ox-hide boots reinforced with heavy iron toes.

items.Properties / Flavor: Includes a copper siphoning tube, hydrometer, fermentation bung, and hops-measuring scales in a crate. It enables brewmasters to ferment ales, stouts, and medicinal herbal wines.
items.Description & Mechanics: Includes a copper siphoning tube, hydrometer, fermentation bung, and hops-measuring scales in a crate. It enables brewmasters to ferment ales, stouts, and medicinal herbal wines.

items.Properties / Flavor: A straight, sturdy ten-foot ash pole that can probe murky waters and test suspicious flagstones. Dungeon explorers tap it ahead of marching ranks to trigger pit traps and pressure plates.
items.Description & Mechanics: A straight, sturdy ten-foot ash pole that can probe murky waters and test suspicious flagstones. Dungeon explorers tap it ahead of marching ranks to trigger pit traps and pressure plates.

items.Properties / Flavor: This heavy portable artillery piece fires explosive lead spheres that deal 4d8 bludgeoning damage and knock targets prone. Thick wrought-iron cannon barrel is mounted on reinforced shoulder braces with recoil-absorbing springs.
items.Description & Mechanics: This heavy portable artillery piece fires explosive lead spheres that deal 4d8 bludgeoning damage and knock targets prone. Thick wrought-iron cannon barrel is mounted on reinforced shoulder braces with recoil-absorbing springs.

items.Properties / Flavor: A wooden pole wrapped in pitch-soaked linen that burns brightly for one full hour. It casts bright illumination across a twenty-foot radius to dispel subterranean darkness.
items.Description & Mechanics: A wooden pole wrapped in pitch-soaked linen that burns brightly for one full hour. It casts bright illumination across a twenty-foot radius to dispel subterranean darkness.

items.Properties / Flavor: A heavy pewter tankard engraved with hops and barley that magically neutralizes intoxication. Any alcoholic beverage consumed from the tankard leaves the drinker completely sober.
items.Description & Mechanics: A heavy pewter tankard engraved with hops and barley that magically neutralizes intoxication. Any alcoholic beverage consumed from the tankard leaves the drinker completely sober.

items.Properties / Flavor: A carved stone flagon sculpted in the shape of a curling wyrm that infuses plain water with draconic magic. Drinking from it grants restorative healing, alchemical fire, or resistance to elemental breaths.
items.Description & Mechanics: A carved stone flagon sculpted in the shape of a curling wyrm that infuses plain water with draconic magic. Drinking from it grants restorative healing, alchemical fire, or resistance to elemental breaths.

items.Properties / Flavor: A simple pewter mug or earthenware drinking tankard that holds one pint of liquid. Common folk and adventurers drink ale, mead, or water from it in taverns across Faerûn.
items.Description & Mechanics: A simple pewter mug or earthenware drinking tankard that holds one pint of liquid. Common folk and adventurers drink ale, mead, or water from it in taverns across Faerûn.

items.Properties / Flavor: A medallion wrought from silver or pewter depicting the sacred holy symbol of a deity. Clerics and paladins wear it around their neck to channel divine spellcasting magic.
items.Description & Mechanics: A medallion wrought from silver or pewter depicting the sacred holy symbol of a deity. Clerics and paladins wear it around their neck to channel divine spellcasting magic.

items.Properties / Flavor: A carved brass or silver plate depicting a divine crest riveted directly onto a shield face. A paladin or cleric uses the decorated shield as a sacred spellcasting focus in combat.
items.Description & Mechanics: A carved brass or silver plate depicting a divine crest riveted directly onto a shield face. A paladin or cleric uses the decorated shield as a sacred spellcasting focus in combat.

items.Properties / Flavor: A wooden box measuring twelve inches long that unfolds into a full-sized rowboat or ship. Speaking command words causes the timber to assemble into a seaworthy vessel within seconds.
items.Description & Mechanics: A wooden box measuring twelve inches long that unfolds into a full-sized rowboat or ship. Speaking command words causes the timber to assemble into a seaworthy vessel within seconds.

items.Properties / Flavor: A reinforced steel ten-foot pole fitted with internal tension springs and release buttons. It collapses down into a compact six-inch rod that can be easily tucked into an adventurer's belt.
items.Description & Mechanics: A reinforced steel ten-foot pole fitted with internal tension springs and release buttons. It collapses down into a compact six-inch rod that can be easily tucked into an adventurer's belt.

items.Properties / Flavor: A rugged woodcutter's broadaxe forged from hardened meteoric iron that hungers for dense wood. It deals triple damage against wooden structures and plant creatures, severing thick trunks effortlessly.
items.Description & Mechanics: A rugged woodcutter's broadaxe forged from hardened meteoric iron that hungers for dense wood. It deals triple damage against wooden structures and plant creatures, severing thick trunks effortlessly.

items.Properties / Flavor: An arcane focus wand carved from evergreen pines harvested from the freezing plane of Risia. Casting spells that deal cold damage causes icy frost to bite deeper into opposing foes.
items.Description & Mechanics: An arcane focus wand carved from evergreen pines harvested from the freezing plane of Risia. Casting spells that deal cold damage causes icy frost to bite deeper into opposing foes.

items.Properties / Flavor: A heavy broadaxe inscribed with sylvan runes of fey timber-craft that sings when swung. It deals maximum damage against plant creatures and wooden structures, cleaving through barriers easily.
items.Description & Mechanics: A heavy broadaxe inscribed with sylvan runes of fey timber-craft that sings when swung. It deals maximum damage against plant creatures and wooden structures, cleaving through barriers easily.

items.Properties / Flavor: This mason's chisel freezes stone or metal on contact to make brittle fractures easy to carve without loud noise. Frost coats the hardened steel tip regardless of ambient temperature.
items.Description & Mechanics: This mason's chisel freezes stone or metal on contact to make brittle fractures easy to carve without loud noise. Frost coats the hardened steel tip regardless of ambient temperature.

items.Properties / Flavor: An ornate throne carved from weirwood and copper that links a spellcaster's mind to a ship's hull. Channelling magic into the seat propels massive galleons across wildspace at supernatural speeds.
items.Description & Mechanics: An ornate throne carved from weirwood and copper that links a spellcaster's mind to a ship's hull. Channelling magic into the seat propels massive galleons across wildspace at supernatural speeds.

items.Properties / Flavor: A powerful, brave breed of guard dog trained to defend homesteads and pull small carts. Small humanoids such as halflings and gnomes frequently ride them into battle as loyal mounts.
items.Description & Mechanics: A powerful, brave breed of guard dog trained to defend homesteads and pull small carts. Small humanoids such as halflings and gnomes frequently ride them into battle as loyal mounts.

items.Properties / Flavor: A leather headstall fitted with a steel bit that rests in a mount's mouth, connected to reins. It allows the rider to steer, brake, and communicate direction to their horse with precision.
items.Description & Mechanics: A leather headstall fitted with a steel bit that rests in a mount's mouth, connected to reins. It allows the rider to steer, brake, and communicate direction to their horse with precision.

items.Properties / Flavor: A reinforced leather saddle fitted with high cantle and pommel supports to brace a mounted warrior. It braces the rider firmly in place, granting advantage on saving throws to avoid being unseated.
items.Description & Mechanics: A reinforced leather saddle fitted with high cantle and pommel supports to brace a mounted warrior. It braces the rider firmly in place, granting advantage on saving throws to avoid being unseated.

items.Properties / Flavor: A comfortable, lightweight leather saddle designed for long-distance trail travel and daily riding. It distributes the rider's weight evenly across the horse's spine to prevent fatigue.
items.Description & Mechanics: A comfortable, lightweight leather saddle designed for long-distance trail travel and daily riding. It distributes the rider's weight evenly across the horse's spine to prevent fatigue.

items.Properties / Flavor: A twin-nozzle brass backpack powered by compressed alchemical steam and volatile kerosene. Igniting the thrusters grants a sixty-foot flying speed and leaves behind a cloud of scalding vapor.
items.Description & Mechanics: A twin-nozzle brass backpack powered by compressed alchemical steam and volatile kerosene. Igniting the thrusters grants a sixty-foot flying speed and leaves behind a cloud of scalding vapor.

items.Properties / Flavor: Fastening this bridle to a mount doubles its overland travel pace and lets the rider cast haste on the mount once per day. Braided red silk reins are fastened with embossed silver bits depicting charging elven stallions.
items.Description & Mechanics: Fastening this bridle to a mount doubles its overland travel pace and lets the rider cast haste on the mount once per day. Braided red silk reins are fastened with embossed silver bits depicting charging elven stallions.

items.Properties / Flavor: Fastening this backpack apparatus deploys four mechanical legs that carry you up sheer walls at forty feet per round. Polished steel gears and articulating piston legs fold neatly behind a leather chest harness.
items.Description & Mechanics: Fastening this backpack apparatus deploys four mechanical legs that carry you up sheer walls at forty feet per round. Polished steel gears and articulating piston legs fold neatly behind a leather chest harness.

items.Properties / Flavor: A segmented steel canister packed with volatile explosive salts that detonate upon impact. Throwing it releases a deafening sonic shockwave that stuns and disorients all creatures in a room.
items.Description & Mechanics: A segmented steel canister packed with volatile explosive salts that detonate upon impact. Throwing it releases a deafening sonic shockwave that stuns and disorients all creatures in a room.

items.Properties / Flavor: A pressurized metal canister filled with stinging alchemical vapor that irritates eyes and lungs. Inhaling the gas causes severe coughing, blindness, and disadvantage on all physical attacks.
items.Description & Mechanics: A pressurized metal canister filled with stinging alchemical vapor that irritates eyes and lungs. Inhaling the gas causes severe coughing, blindness, and disadvantage on all physical attacks.

items.Properties / Flavor: A pinch of sparkling azure sand that absorbs surrounding heat when tossed into the air. It conjures a fifty-foot oasis of cool shade and fresh spring water that lasts for eight hours.
items.Description & Mechanics: A pinch of sparkling azure sand that absorbs surrounding heat when tossed into the air. It conjures a fifty-foot oasis of cool shade and fresh spring water that lasts for eight hours.

items.Properties / Flavor: A sling bullet or firearm round cast from lead infused with pulverized delerium dust. Striking a target detonates a chaotic temporal burst that teleports the victim twenty feet in a random direction.
items.Description & Mechanics: A sling bullet or firearm round cast from lead infused with pulverized delerium dust. Striking a target detonates a chaotic temporal burst that teleports the victim twenty feet in a random direction.

items.Properties / Flavor: Planting this enchanted acorn into soil instantly grows a thirty-foot defensible tree or casts plant growth in the area. A massive petrified golden acorn pulses with the raw fertility of the Primordial Forest.
items.Description & Mechanics: Planting this enchanted acorn into soil instantly grows a thirty-foot defensible tree or casts plant growth in the area. A massive petrified golden acorn pulses with the raw fertility of the Primordial Forest.

items.Properties / Flavor: Burning this bundle of dried herbs cleanses the area of foul odors and provides advantage on saves against airborne spores. Dried sage, lavender, and sweetgrass are tied tightly together with natural hemp twine.
items.Description & Mechanics: Burning this bundle of dried herbs cleanses the area of foul odors and provides advantage on saves against airborne spores. Dried sage, lavender, and sweetgrass are tied tightly together with natural hemp twine.

items.Properties / Flavor: A cured leather bladder lined with beeswax and secured by a tethered wooden stopper. It carries four pints of fresh drinking water to sustain an adventurer through arid wilderness treks.
items.Description & Mechanics: A cured leather bladder lined with beeswax and secured by a tethered wooden stopper. It carries four pints of fresh drinking water to sustain an adventurer through arid wilderness treks.

items.Properties / Flavor: A braided cord of dark fibrous tendrils that writhes hungrily when thrown toward a target. It snares and binds a creature within twenty feet, restraining them in an unbreakable knot.
items.Description & Mechanics: A braided cord of dark fibrous tendrils that writhes hungrily when thrown toward a target. It snares and binds a creature within twenty feet, restraining them in an unbreakable knot.

items.Properties / Flavor: A heavy backpack holding a crowbar, hammer, ten pitons, ten torches, a tinderbox, rations, and waterskin. It contains the essential baseline survival equipment required to explore dark dungeon ruins.
items.Description & Mechanics: A heavy backpack holding a crowbar, hammer, ten pitons, ten torches, a tinderbox, rations, and waterskin. It contains the essential baseline survival equipment required to explore dark dungeon ruins.

items.Properties / Flavor: A colorful backpack filled with a bedroll, two theatrical costumes, candles, rations, waterskin, and disguise kit items. It allows traveling bards and acrobats to perform across tavern circuits in style.
items.Description & Mechanics: A colorful backpack filled with a bedroll, two theatrical costumes, candles, rations, waterskin, and disguise kit items. It allows traveling bards and acrobats to perform across tavern circuits in style.

items.Properties / Flavor: A sturdy backpack containing a bedroll, mess kit, tinderbox, ten torches, ten days of rations, and waterskin. It provides all necessary wilderness sustenance for long-distance expeditions across untamed terrain.
items.Description & Mechanics: A sturdy backpack containing a bedroll, mess kit, tinderbox, ten torches, ten days of rations, and waterskin. It provides all necessary wilderness sustenance for long-distance expeditions across untamed terrain.

items.Properties / Flavor: Two bulbous glass chambers set into an ornate brass cage filled with measured fine sand. It trickles with precise accuracy to measure sixty minutes for magical rituals or timed infiltrations.
items.Description & Mechanics: Two bulbous glass chambers set into an ornate brass cage filled with measured fine sand. It trickles with precise accuracy to measure sixty minutes for magical rituals or timed infiltrations.

items.Properties / Flavor: A polished brass dodecahedron that ticks with absolute mathematical rhythm when wound. Placing it on the ground creates a field of order that cancels wild magic surges for one hour.
items.Description & Mechanics: A polished brass dodecahedron that ticks with absolute mathematical rhythm when wound. Placing it on the ground creates a field of order that cancels wild magic surges for one hour.

items.Properties / Flavor: A tin case containing a shallow frying pan, plate, cup, and nesting fork, knife, and spoon. The kit clasps together tightly for clean storage inside an adventurer's backpack.
items.Description & Mechanics: A tin case containing a shallow frying pan, plate, cup, and nesting fork, knife, and spoon. The kit clasps together tightly for clean storage inside an adventurer's backpack.

items.Properties / Flavor: A balanced brass balance scale equipped with graduated weights and copper weighing pans. Merchants use it to weigh precious coin clippings, raw gemstone nuggets, and alchemical powders.
items.Description & Mechanics: A balanced brass balance scale equipped with graduated weights and copper weighing pans. Merchants use it to weigh precious coin clippings, raw gemstone nuggets, and alchemical powders.

items.Properties / Flavor: A small carved bone or brass whistle that produces a shrill, piercing blast across long distances. Scouts and city guards use it to signal distress or coordinate tactical team maneuvers.
items.Description & Mechanics: A small carved bone or brass whistle that produces a shrill, piercing blast across long distances. Scouts and city guards use it to signal distress or coordinate tactical team maneuvers.

items.Properties / Flavor: Blowing this wrought-iron whistle summons a pair of fiery spectral hounds to track quarry across any terrain for one hour. Hot soot and faint embers puff from the mouth of the whistle with every breath.
items.Description & Mechanics: Blowing this wrought-iron whistle summons a pair of fiery spectral hounds to track quarry across any terrain for one hour. Hot soot and faint embers puff from the mouth of the whistle with every breath.

items.Properties / Flavor: A palm-sized plate of polished steel protected within a hinged wooden casing. It lets explorers peek around dangerous dungeon corners or signal companions across sunlit valleys.
items.Description & Mechanics: A palm-sized plate of polished steel protected within a hinged wooden casing. It lets explorers peek around dangerous dungeon corners or signal companions across sunlit valleys.

items.Properties / Flavor: A spring-loaded iron jaw trap fitted with razor teeth that snaps shut when stepped upon. Chained to a tree or heavy stake, it restrains beasts and imposes physical puncture damage.
items.Description & Mechanics: A spring-loaded iron jaw trap fitted with razor teeth that snaps shut when stepped upon. Chained to a tree or heavy stake, it restrains beasts and imposes physical puncture damage.

items.Properties / Flavor: A personalized gold or brass ring engraved with a family crest, mercantile mark, or guild emblem. Pressing it into hot sealing wax leaves an official mark on letters and legal warrants.
items.Description & Mechanics: A personalized gold or brass ring engraved with a family crest, mercantile mark, or guild emblem. Pressing it into hot sealing wax leaves an official mark on letters and legal warrants.

items.Properties / Flavor: A spiraling electrum band set with a pulsing cerulean conduit stone that channels raw aether. It siphon excess magical discharge from incoming enemy spells to replenish the wearer's spell slots.
items.Description & Mechanics: A spiraling electrum band set with a pulsing cerulean conduit stone that channels raw aether. It siphon excess magical discharge from incoming enemy spells to replenish the wearer's spell slots.

items.Properties / Flavor: A heavy silver chain adorned with carved platinum gills and bubble-shaped moonstones. It surrounds the wearer's neck with fresh air, allowing underwater breathing and immunity to toxic gases.
items.Description & Mechanics: A heavy silver chain adorned with carved platinum gills and bubble-shaped moonstones. It surrounds the wearer's neck with fresh air, allowing underwater breathing and immunity to toxic gases.

items.Properties / Flavor: A silver pendant set with a polished bloodstone shaped like a teardrop. It instantly stabilizes the dying wearer at the start of their turns and doubles hit point recovery from hit dice.
items.Description & Mechanics: A silver pendant set with a polished bloodstone shaped like a teardrop. It instantly stabilizes the dying wearer at the start of their turns and doubles hit point recovery from hit dice.

items.Properties / Flavor: A slender gold band engraved with delicate downy feathers that feel weightless on the finger. When the wearer falls, it instantly casts feather fall to ensure a safe, drifting descent.
items.Description & Mechanics: A slender gold band engraved with delicate downy feathers that feel weightless on the finger. When the wearer falls, it instantly casts feather fall to ensure a safe, drifting descent.

items.Properties / Flavor: A band of intertwined electrum loops that spin freely around each other without friction. It ensures difficult terrain does not impede your movement and makes you immune to paralysis.
items.Description & Mechanics: A band of intertwined electrum loops that spin freely around each other without friction. It ensures difficult terrain does not impede your movement and makes you immune to paralysis.

items.Properties / Flavor: A heavy ring carved from a single piece of dark lapis lazuli and lined with silver filigree. It stores up to five levels of spells cast into it, allowing any wearer to unleash them later.
items.Description & Mechanics: A heavy ring carved from a single piece of dark lapis lazuli and lined with silver filigree. It stores up to five levels of spells cast into it, allowing any wearer to unleash them later.

items.Properties / Flavor: A polished silver ring set with an aquamarine that ripples like liquid when exposed to moonlight. It allows the wearer to stride across any liquid surface as if it were firm solid ground.
items.Description & Mechanics: A polished silver ring set with an aquamarine that ripples like liquid when exposed to moonlight. It allows the wearer to stride across any liquid surface as if it were firm solid ground.

items.Properties / Flavor: A flexible silver band carved with coiled grasshopper legs that tightens comfortably on the finger. It allows the wearer to cast jump on themselves as a bonus action at will.
items.Description & Mechanics: A flexible silver band carved with coiled grasshopper legs that tightens comfortably on the finger. It allows the wearer to cast jump on themselves as a bonus action at will.

items.Properties / Flavor: A heavy gold ring set with a clear quartz intaglio depicting a fortress gate. It shields the wearer from telepathic intrusions and conceals their alignment from magical detection.
items.Description & Mechanics: A heavy gold ring set with a clear quartz intaglio depicting a fortress gate. It shields the wearer from telepathic intrusions and conceals their alignment from magical detection.

items.Properties / Flavor: A heavy copper band sculpted with three animal heads: a wolf, an owl, and an eagle. It allows the wearer to cast animal friendship, fear against beasts, or speak with animals.
items.Description & Mechanics: A heavy copper band sculpted with three animal heads: a wolf, an owl, and an eagle. It allows the wearer to cast animal friendship, fear against beasts, or speak with animals.

items.Properties / Flavor: A heavy lead ring set with a cloudy beryl stone that becomes transparent when pressed. It allows the wearer to see through up to one foot of solid stone, wood, or dirt to spot hidden chambers.
items.Description & Mechanics: A heavy lead ring set with a cloudy beryl stone that becomes transparent when pressed. It allows the wearer to see through up to one foot of solid stone, wood, or dirt to spot hidden chambers.

items.Properties / Flavor: A plain iron ring inscribed with the military pledge of a royal house or mercenary company. If the wearer drops to zero hit points, the ring instantly ends their life to prevent capture and interrogation.
items.Description & Mechanics: A plain iron ring inscribed with the military pledge of a royal house or mercenary company. If the wearer drops to zero hit points, the ring instantly ends their life to prevent capture and interrogation.

items.Properties / Flavor: A silver ring set with an aerogel sphere that traps a microscopic bubble of pure atmospheric air. In vacuum or toxic atmospheres, it projects a clean air envelope around the wearer for one hour.
items.Description & Mechanics: A silver ring set with an aerogel sphere that traps a microscopic bubble of pure atmospheric air. In vacuum or toxic atmospheres, it projects a clean air envelope around the wearer for one hour.

items.Properties / Flavor: A brass band set with a smoldering fire opal that feels reassuringly warm against the finger. It grants the wearer permanent resistance to all forms of fire damage.
items.Description & Mechanics: A brass band set with a smoldering fire opal that feels reassuringly warm against the finger. It grants the wearer permanent resistance to all forms of fire damage.

items.Properties / Flavor: A pale silver ring set with an everlasting sapphire that never loses its freezing chill. It protects the wearer with permanent resistance against all cold damage.
items.Description & Mechanics: A pale silver ring set with an everlasting sapphire that never loses its freezing chill. It protects the wearer with permanent resistance against all cold damage.

items.Properties / Flavor: A copper ring shaped like a coiling snake set with a sparkling blue topaz. It absorbs electrical shockwaves, granting the bearer permanent resistance to lightning damage.
items.Description & Mechanics: A copper ring shaped like a coiling snake set with a sparkling blue topaz. It absorbs electrical shockwaves, granting the bearer permanent resistance to lightning damage.

items.Properties / Flavor: A ring carved from dark jade that resists corrosive alchemical degradation. The wearer gains continuous resistance against caustic fluids, bile, and acid damage.
items.Description & Mechanics: A ring carved from dark jade that resists corrosive alchemical degradation. The wearer gains continuous resistance against caustic fluids, bile, and acid damage.

items.Properties / Flavor: A band of blackened silver set with an onyx intaglio depicting an unyielding skull. It shields the wearer's life essence with permanent resistance to necrotic damage.
items.Description & Mechanics: A band of blackened silver set with an onyx intaglio depicting an unyielding skull. It shields the wearer's life essence with permanent resistance to necrotic damage.

items.Properties / Flavor: A band of dense adamantine inlaid with pure crystalline quartz that deflects kinetic energy. It grants the wearer permanent damage resistance against magical force damage.
items.Description & Mechanics: A band of dense adamantine inlaid with pure crystalline quartz that deflects kinetic energy. It grants the wearer permanent damage resistance against magical force damage.

items.Properties / Flavor: A woven platinum band set with a purple amethyst that hums with serene mental stillness. It fortifies the wearer's mind, granting permanent resistance to psychic trauma.
items.Description & Mechanics: A woven platinum band set with a purple amethyst that hums with serene mental stillness. It fortifies the wearer's mind, granting permanent resistance to psychic trauma.

items.Description & Mechanics: A silver ring set with an unyielding white pearl that warms whenever deception is spoken nearby. It grants advantage on insight checks to detect lies and allows the wearer to cast zone of truth.

items.Properties / Flavor: You can use an action to telekinetically push or pull an enemy up to twenty feet toward or away from you. A cabochon moonstone is set into a band of twisting aquamarine waves and silver foam.
items.Description & Mechanics: You can use an action to telekinetically push or pull an enemy up to twenty feet toward or away from you. A cabochon moonstone is set into a band of twisting aquamarine waves and silver foam.

items.Properties / Flavor: This ring grants resistance to cold damage and allows you to unleash a fifteen-foot cone of freezing breath once per dawn. Carved from blue ice that never melts, the band is engraved with snarling wolf fangs.
items.Description & Mechanics: This ring grants resistance to cold damage and allows you to unleash a fifteen-foot cone of freezing breath once per dawn. Carved from blue ice that never melts, the band is engraved with snarling wolf fangs.

items.Properties / Flavor: A knife forged from shadowfell glass that vanishes from sight when cloaked in darkness. Landing a sneak attack from dim light teleports the wielder into adjacent shadows.
items.Description & Mechanics: A knife forged from shadowfell glass that vanishes from sight when cloaked in darkness. Landing a sneak attack from dim light teleports the wielder into adjacent shadows.

items.Properties / Flavor: A sleek stiletto forged from dark shadowfell obsidian that whispers dark secrets to its wielder. Striking a target from stealth leaves them deafened and silenced by swirling magical shadows.
items.Description & Mechanics: A sleek stiletto forged from dark shadowfell obsidian that whispers dark secrets to its wielder. Striking a target from stealth leaves them deafened and silenced by swirling magical shadows.

items.Properties / Flavor: A ceremonial dagger whose guard is sculpted like the coiled wings of a young silver dragon. It deals bonus cold damage on strike and sheds soft silver moonlight across a fifteen-foot radius.
items.Description & Mechanics: A ceremonial dagger whose guard is sculpted like the coiled wings of a young silver dragon. It deals bonus cold damage on strike and sheds soft silver moonlight across a fifteen-foot radius.

items.Properties / Flavor: A stiletto forged from dark shadow-metal that vanishes from perception when drawn in darkness. Striking a target from stealth leaves them blinded and silences their vocal cords for one minute.
items.Description & Mechanics: A stiletto forged from dark shadow-metal that vanishes from perception when drawn in darkness. Striking a target from stealth leaves them blinded and silences their vocal cords for one minute.

items.Properties / Flavor: A pair of curved punch daggers carved from the talons of an apex hunting raptor. Wielding both blades simultaneously allows the fighter to execute rapid rending cross-slashes in melee.
items.Description & Mechanics: A pair of curved punch daggers carved from the talons of an apex hunting raptor. Wielding both blades simultaneously allows the fighter to execute rapid rending cross-slashes in melee.

items.Properties / Flavor: A sharpened hawthorn stake treated with alchemical tracking tinctures that drinks blood on contact. Impaling an undead or beast allows the hunter to track the quarry across infinite distances.
items.Description & Mechanics: A sharpened hawthorn stake treated with alchemical tracking tinctures that drinks blood on contact. Impaling an undead or beast allows the hunter to track the quarry across infinite distances.

items.Properties / Flavor: A compact stabbing knife forged from unblemished cold iron designed for occult monster slaying. It bypasses supernatural damage reductions, dealing true physical trauma against devils and hags.
items.Description & Mechanics: A compact stabbing knife forged from unblemished cold iron designed for occult monster slaying. It bypasses supernatural damage reductions, dealing true physical trauma against devils and hags.

items.Properties / Flavor: Attuned psionic wielders add their Intelligence or Wisdom modifier to damage rolls made with this crystalline piercing weapon. Translucent amber crysteel is grown from psionically resonant sand mined in Sarlona.
items.Description & Mechanics: Attuned psionic wielders add their Intelligence or Wisdom modifier to damage rolls made with this crystalline piercing weapon. Translucent amber crysteel is grown from psionically resonant sand mined in Sarlona.

items.Properties / Flavor: Cutting your own palm with this ritual dagger empowers your next damaging spell with an extra 2d8 necrotic damage. A curved obsidian blade is bound to a bone handle stained with dried sacrificial crimson.
items.Description & Mechanics: Cutting your own palm with this ritual dagger empowers your next damaging spell with an extra 2d8 necrotic damage. A curved obsidian blade is bound to a bone handle stained with dried sacrificial crimson.

items.Properties / Flavor: A heavy crossbow fitted with an alchemical reservoir that bathes loaded bolts in clinging liquid fire. Struck targets ignite in roaring flames that burn continuously until extinguished by water.
items.Description & Mechanics: A heavy crossbow fitted with an alchemical reservoir that bathes loaded bolts in clinging liquid fire. Struck targets ignite in roaring flames that burn continuously until extinguished by water.

items.Properties / Flavor: A smooth, polished Eberron dragonshard that stores up to one hundred pages of text and illustrations. Placing a finger on the crystal projects glowing illusory text directly into the bearer's mind.
items.Description & Mechanics: A smooth, polished Eberron dragonshard that stores up to one hundred pages of text and illustrations. Placing a finger on the crystal projects glowing illusory text directly into the bearer's mind.

items.Properties / Flavor: A pair of linked leather bags designed to drape across the rear of a riding or pack saddle. They provide twenty pounds of convenient exterior storage for rations, bedrolls, and waterskins.
items.Description & Mechanics: A pair of linked leather bags designed to drape across the rear of a riding or pack saddle. They provide twenty pounds of convenient exterior storage for rations, bedrolls, and waterskins.

items.Properties / Flavor: A band of polished turquoise carved with overlapping fish scales that remains cool against the skin. It grants the wearer a swimming speed of forty feet through turbulent waters.
items.Description & Mechanics: A band of polished turquoise carved with overlapping fish scales that remains cool against the skin. It grants the wearer a swimming speed of forty feet through turbulent waters.

items.Properties / Flavor: A glowing crimson draught that sparkles with radiant motes when gently swirled in its glass vial. It rapidly closes severe lacerations and soothes broken bones to deliver potent restorative healing.
items.Description & Mechanics: A glowing crimson draught that sparkles with radiant motes when gently swirled in its glass vial. It rapidly closes severe lacerations and soothes broken bones to deliver potent restorative healing.

items.Properties / Flavor: Constructed from boiled leather hardened in hot oil and stitched together with supple shoulder joints. It provides baseline protection while allowing total freedom of stealthy movement.
items.Description & Mechanics: Constructed from boiled leather hardened in hot oil and stitched together with supple shoulder joints. It provides baseline protection while allowing total freedom of stealthy movement.

items.Properties / Flavor: A stiff leather hip holster embossed with brass gear etchings and quick-draw silver buckles. It magically feeds ammunition into holstered sidearms and allows the wearer to draw with lightning speed.
items.Description & Mechanics: A stiff leather hip holster embossed with brass gear etchings and quick-draw silver buckles. It magically feeds ammunition into holstered sidearms and allows the wearer to draw with lightning speed.

items.Properties / Flavor: Finely cured leather armor reinforced with subtle mithral studs that feels like soft silk. Speaking a command word disguises the armor as ordinary fashionable clothing of any style.
items.Description & Mechanics: Finely cured leather armor reinforced with subtle mithral studs that feels like soft silk. Speaking a command word disguises the armor as ordinary fashionable clothing of any style.

items.Properties / Flavor: A leather sling woven with shimmering golden fleece cords that manipulates ricochet trajectories. When a projectile launched from this sling strikes a creature, it ricochets to hit a second target within ten feet.
items.Description & Mechanics: A leather sling woven with shimmering golden fleece cords that manipulates ricochet trajectories. When a projectile launched from this sling strikes a creature, it ricochets to hit a second target within ten feet.

items.Properties / Flavor: A tailored suit of vulcanized leather reinforced with airtight seals and brass pressure valves. It provides total environmental protection in astral space and allows thruster-assisted maneuvering.
items.Description & Mechanics: A tailored suit of vulcanized leather reinforced with airtight seals and brass pressure valves. It provides total environmental protection in astral space and allows thruster-assisted maneuvering.

items.Properties / Flavor: A rust-colored leather pouch that contains enchanted fuzz balls attuned to wilderness creatures. Throwing a ball manifests friendly beasts such as brown bears, giant badgers, or mastiffs.
items.Description & Mechanics: A rust-colored leather pouch that contains enchanted fuzz balls attuned to wilderness creatures. Throwing a ball manifests friendly beasts such as brown bears, giant badgers, or mastiffs.

items.Properties / Flavor: A supple leather sash adorned with hanging brass bells that emit embers when jingling. It grants fire resistance, boosts acrobatics checks, and wreaths the wearer's kicks in scorching flames.
items.Description & Mechanics: A supple leather sash adorned with hanging brass bells that emit embers when jingling. It grants fire resistance, boosts acrobatics checks, and wreaths the wearer's kicks in scorching flames.
