items.Properties / Flavor: A spherical glass compass holding a glowing speck of stardust floating in zero-gravity oil. It points constantly toward the gravitational center of the current wildspace planetary system.
items.Description & Mechanics: A spherical glass compass holding a glowing speck of stardust floating in zero-gravity oil. It points constantly toward the gravitational center of the current wildspace planetary system.

items.Properties / Flavor: A series of graduated cane pipes bound together with waxed cords that produce breathy hollow tones. Satyrs and woodland bards play it to charm wild beasts and soothe restless companions.
items.Description & Mechanics: A series of graduated cane pipes bound together with waxed cords that produce breathy hollow tones. Satyrs and woodland bards play it to charm wild beasts and soothe restless companions.

items.Properties / Flavor: A freshly harvested sprig of golden mistletoe clipped with a golden sickle under moonlight. A druid holds it to channel primal nature energies for spellcasting incantations.
items.Description & Mechanics: A freshly harvested sprig of golden mistletoe clipped with a golden sickle under moonlight. A druid holds it to channel primal nature energies for spellcasting incantations.

items.Properties / Flavor: The silver needle of this celestial device always points toward the nearest planar portal or astral rift within one mile. Polished brass casing holds a face engraved with ancient constellations and starmaps.
items.Description & Mechanics: The silver needle of this celestial device always points toward the nearest planar portal or astral rift within one mile. Polished brass casing holds a face engraved with ancient constellations and starmaps.

items.Properties / Flavor: This versatile steel blade features a double-edged design suitable for slashing or thrusting with one or two hands. It is standard military armament favored by guards and knights across the Sword Coast.
items.Description & Mechanics: This versatile steel blade features a double-edged design suitable for slashing or thrusting with one or two hands. It is standard military armament favored by guards and knights across the Sword Coast.

items.Properties / Flavor: A compact steel blade designed for close-quarters fighting, quick concealment, or precision throwing. It serves equally well as a reliable camp utility tool or a deadly off-hand weapon.
items.Description & Mechanics: A compact steel blade designed for close-quarters fighting, quick concealment, or precision throwing. It serves equally well as a reliable camp utility tool or a deadly off-hand weapon.

items.Properties / Flavor: A short curved crescent blade originally designed for harvesting grains and wild herbs. Druids and rural folk wield it in close combat to deliver hooking, flesh-tearing slashes.
items.Description & Mechanics: A short curved crescent blade originally designed for harvesting grains and wild herbs. Druids and rural folk wield it in close combat to deliver hooking, flesh-tearing slashes.

items.Properties / Flavor: A dense steel ball studded with vicious spikes affixed to a reinforced metal haft. It delivers puncture wounds combined with blunt trauma to bypass heavy layers of padding.
items.Description & Mechanics: A dense steel ball studded with vicious spikes affixed to a reinforced metal haft. It delivers puncture wounds combined with blunt trauma to bypass heavy layers of padding.

items.Properties / Flavor: A sharp, pointed curved beak of hardened steel designed specifically to puncture heavy plate. Sapper units and cavalrymen use it to deliver concentrated kinetic strikes through rigid metal.
items.Description & Mechanics: A sharp, pointed curved beak of hardened steel designed specifically to puncture heavy plate. Sapper units and cavalrymen use it to deliver concentrated kinetic strikes through rigid metal.

items.Properties / Flavor: A triangular steel spike designed to lock securely over the muzzle of a firearm. It transforms a ranged blackpowder weapon into a formidable thrusting spear during close melee emergencies.
items.Description & Mechanics: A triangular steel spike designed to lock securely over the muzzle of a firearm. It transforms a ranged blackpowder weapon into a formidable thrusting spear during close melee emergencies.

items.Properties / Flavor: A silvered steel longsword that glows with the soft, ethereal brilliance of moonlight in darkness. It sheds bright moonlight across a fifteen-foot radius to reveal lurking nocturnal predators.
items.Description & Mechanics: A silvered steel longsword that glows with the soft, ethereal brilliance of moonlight in darkness. It sheds bright moonlight across a fifteen-foot radius to reveal lurking nocturnal predators.

items.Properties / Flavor: A single-handed front-loading firearm fitted with a flint striker and a flared steel muzzle. It offers a lethal close-range opening shot before drawing a melee blade in gritty duels.
items.Description & Mechanics: A single-handed front-loading firearm fitted with a flint striker and a flared steel muzzle. It offers a lethal close-range opening shot before drawing a melee blade in gritty duels.

items.Properties / Flavor: A traditional Chultan short stabbing spear consisting of a three-foot wooden shaft fitted with an eighteen-inch steel blade. It delivers devastating thrusts in close-quarters skirmishes and can be hurled short distances.
items.Description & Mechanics: A traditional Chultan short stabbing spear consisting of a three-foot wooden shaft fitted with an eighteen-inch steel blade. It delivers devastating thrusts in close-quarters skirmishes and can be hurled short distances.

items.Properties / Flavor: A heavy steel longsword serrated with jagged iron spikes engineered to splinter enemy armaments. Striking a nonmagical weapon or object lands automatic critical hits to shatter shields and sunder structural barricades.
items.Description & Mechanics: A heavy steel longsword serrated with jagged iron spikes engineered to splinter enemy armaments. Striking a nonmagical weapon or object lands automatic critical hits to shatter shields and sunder structural barricades.

items.Properties / Flavor: A sinister blade carved from dark meteor steel that drinks in the vital warmth of living flesh. Scoring a critical hit deals extra necrotic damage and grants the wielder ten temporary hit points.
items.Description & Mechanics: A sinister blade carved from dark meteor steel that drinks in the vital warmth of living flesh. Scoring a critical hit deals extra necrotic damage and grants the wielder ten temporary hit points.

items.Properties / Flavor: A broad curved steel axe blade mounted on a reinforced wooden haft designed for one or two-handed swings. It serves as traditional dwarven and vanguard infantry armament across Faerûn.
items.Description & Mechanics: A broad curved steel axe blade mounted on a reinforced wooden haft designed for one or two-handed swings. It serves as traditional dwarven and vanguard infantry armament across Faerûn.

items.Properties / Flavor: A steel longsword professionally plated with pure alchemical silver along its double-edged cutting surface. It bypasses the damage immunities of lycanthropes, devils, and incorporeal wraiths.
items.Description & Mechanics: A steel longsword professionally plated with pure alchemical silver along its double-edged cutting surface. It bypasses the damage immunities of lycanthropes, devils, and incorporeal wraiths.

items.Properties / Flavor: A curved steel blade etched with divination constellations along its central fuller. Piercing a target grants glimpses of their next attack, allowing the wielder to parry with uncanny foresight.
items.Description & Mechanics: A curved steel blade etched with divination constellations along its central fuller. Piercing a target grants glimpses of their next attack, allowing the wielder to parry with uncanny foresight.

items.Properties / Flavor: A lightning-etched longsword forged from conductive starmetal that roars with thunderstorm winds. Striking a target discharges branching lightning arcs that jump to shock adjacent enemies.
items.Description & Mechanics: A lightning-etched longsword forged from conductive starmetal that roars with thunderstorm winds. Striking a target discharges branching lightning arcs that jump to shock adjacent enemies.

items.Properties / Flavor: A blackened steel blade etched with midnight moonstones along its fuller that absorbs ambient sound. Attacks made with this dagger create a sphere of silence that prevents victims from crying out.
items.Description & Mechanics: A blackened steel blade etched with midnight moonstones along its fuller that absorbs ambient sound. Attacks made with this dagger create a sphere of silence that prevents victims from crying out.

items.Properties / Flavor: A bearded battleaxe forged in glacial dwarven holds whose steel blade stays coated in biting frost. Striking a target inflicts severe cold damage and coats their armor in heavy, encumbering ice.
items.Description & Mechanics: A bearded battleaxe forged in glacial dwarven holds whose steel blade stays coated in biting frost. Striking a target inflicts severe cold damage and coats their armor in heavy, encumbering ice.

items.Properties / Flavor: A steel longsword whose cutting edge is embedded with jagged violet delerium crystal shards. It strikes with volatile eldritch force, dealing bonus psychic damage and cutting through abjuration wards.
items.Description & Mechanics: A steel longsword whose cutting edge is embedded with jagged violet delerium crystal shards. It strikes with volatile eldritch force, dealing bonus psychic damage and cutting through abjuration wards.

items.Properties / Flavor: This +2 greatsword deals an extra 2d6 cold damage and can freeze standing water into ice sheets beneath your boots. Glacial blue steel carries a permanent frost sheen that chills the air around its massive blade.
items.Description & Mechanics: This +2 greatsword deals an extra 2d6 cold damage and can freeze standing water into ice sheets beneath your boots. Glacial blue steel carries a permanent frost sheen that chills the air around its massive blade.

items.Properties / Flavor: This +1 longsword grants advantage on initiative rolls and allows the wielder to issue a tactical commander's strike as a bonus action. Traditional kech sharaat craftsmanship balances razor edges with a wide protective crossguard.
items.Description & Mechanics: This +1 longsword grants advantage on initiative rolls and allows the wielder to issue a tactical commander's strike as a bonus action. Traditional kech sharaat craftsmanship balances razor edges with a wide protective crossguard.

items.Properties / Flavor: This +1 longsword deals an additional 1d6 psychic damage and can sever ethereal silver cords on a critical strike. The blade is carved from resonant purple-tinged crysteel quartz that rings when drawn.
items.Description & Mechanics: This +1 longsword deals an additional 1d6 psychic damage and can sever ethereal silver cords on a critical strike. The blade is carved from resonant purple-tinged crysteel quartz that rings when drawn.

items.Properties / Flavor: You can use a bonus action to transform this weapon between a fast serrated short-cleaver and an extended reach long-blade. Jagged steel teeth line the heavy curved head, hinged to an iron-wrapped handle.
items.Description & Mechanics: You can use a bonus action to transform this weapon between a fast serrated short-cleaver and an extended reach long-blade. Jagged steel teeth line the heavy curved head, hinged to an iron-wrapped handle.

items.Properties / Flavor: Whenever you reduce a minion or low-tier foe to zero hit points, any leftover damage carries over to another adjacent enemy. A broad cleaving blade of tempered steel features a thick reinforced spine and leather grip.
items.Description & Mechanics: Whenever you reduce a minion or low-tier foe to zero hit points, any leftover damage carries over to another adjacent enemy. A broad cleaving blade of tempered steel features a thick reinforced spine and leather grip.

items.Properties / Flavor: A durable waxed canvas pack equipped with leather shoulder straps and external tie-down loops. It holds up to thirty pounds of expedition gear while distributing weight evenly across the back.
items.Description & Mechanics: A durable waxed canvas pack equipped with leather shoulder straps and external tie-down loops. It holds up to thirty pounds of expedition gear while distributing weight evenly across the back.

items.Properties / Flavor: A rugged leather backpack fitted with two side pouches and an expansive central extradimensional compartment. Whatever item you reach for always springs directly to the top of the pack for instant retrieval.
items.Description & Mechanics: A rugged leather backpack fitted with two side pouches and an expansive central extradimensional compartment. Whatever item you reach for always springs directly to the top of the pack for instant retrieval.

items.Properties / Flavor: A satchel holding a blanket, ten candles, a tinderbox, an alms box, blocks of incense, and vestments. It equips itinerant clerics and paladins to conduct holy rites, blessings, and funerary rituals.
items.Description & Mechanics: A satchel holding a blanket, ten candles, a tinderbox, an alms box, blocks of incense, and vestments. It equips itinerant clerics and paladins to conduct holy rites, blessings, and funerary rituals.

items.Properties / Flavor: A leather satchel containing a book of historical lore, ink bottles, pens, sheets of parchment, and sand. It provides researchers and arcane apprentices with the tools needed to record field observations.
items.Description & Mechanics: A leather satchel containing a book of historical lore, ink bottles, pens, sheets of parchment, and sand. It provides researchers and arcane apprentices with the tools needed to record field observations.

items.Properties / Flavor: A leather-bound volume containing eighty blank sheets of pressed vellum stitched with linen cord. Scholars and explorers use it to record expedition journals, anatomical sketches, or maps.
items.Description & Mechanics: A leather-bound volume containing eighty blank sheets of pressed vellum stitched with linen cord. Scholars and explorers use it to record expedition journals, anatomical sketches, or maps.

items.Properties / Flavor: A tightly folded silk canopy packed inside a canvas backpack equipped with a quick-release rip cord. Pulling the cord while falling slows descent rate to safe speeds, preventing falling damage.
items.Description & Mechanics: A tightly folded silk canopy packed inside a canvas backpack equipped with a quick-release rip cord. Pulling the cord while falling slows descent rate to safe speeds, preventing falling damage.

items.Properties / Flavor: A broad forged iron spade fixed to a reinforced ash handle for clearing earth and digging trenches. Explorers utilize it to unearth buried ruins, dig fortifications, or excavate treasure caches.
items.Description & Mechanics: A broad forged iron spade fixed to a reinforced ash handle for clearing earth and digging trenches. Explorers utilize it to unearth buried ruins, dig fortifications, or excavate treasure caches.

items.Properties / Flavor: An iron judicial mallet inscribed with the Venn rune of friendship and truth. Striking it creates an impenetrable dome of protective force that shields companions from missile barrages.
items.Description & Mechanics: An iron judicial mallet inscribed with the Venn rune of friendship and truth. Striking it creates an impenetrable dome of protective force that shields companions from missile barrages.

items.Properties / Flavor: A wooden tool roll holding saws, hand planes, chisels, an adze, claw hammer, and measuring squares. It allows carpenters to construct wooden barricades, repair carts, and frame shelters.
items.Description & Mechanics: A wooden tool roll holding saws, hand planes, chisels, an adze, claw hammer, and measuring squares. It allows carpenters to construct wooden barricades, repair carts, and frame shelters.

items.Properties / Flavor: A velvet pouch holding jeweler's saws, micro-calipers, gemstone tweezers, magnifying loupes, and burnishers. It equips lapidaries to cut gemstones, assay precious jewelry, and set arcane foci.
items.Description & Mechanics: A velvet pouch holding jeweler's saws, micro-calipers, gemstone tweezers, magnifying loupes, and burnishers. It equips lapidaries to cut gemstones, assay precious jewelry, and set arcane foci.

items.Properties / Flavor: A roll containing rotary leather cutters, edge bevelers, stitching groovers, mallets, and punch needles. It allows crafters to tailor leather armor, repair saddle straps, and shape scabbards.
items.Description & Mechanics: A roll containing rotary leather cutters, edge bevelers, stitching groovers, mallets, and punch needles. It allows crafters to tailor leather armor, repair saddle straps, and shape scabbards.

items.Properties / Flavor: Includes wooden potter's ribs, wire clay cutters, trimming tools, loop blades, and sculpting sponges. It allows artisans to throw ceramic storage jars, cooking pots, and alchemical alembics.
items.Description & Mechanics: Includes wooden potter's ribs, wire clay cutters, trimming tools, loop blades, and sculpting sponges. It allows artisans to throw ceramic storage jars, cooking pots, and alchemical alembics.

items.Properties / Flavor: A set of gouges, curved carving knives, micro-rasps, and sharpening whetstones in a leather sleeve. It allows woodworkers to carve wooden holy symbols, sculpt wands, and fletch arrows.
items.Description & Mechanics: A set of gouges, curved carving knives, micro-rasps, and sharpening whetstones in a leather sleeve. It allows woodworkers to carve wooden holy symbols, sculpt wands, and fletch arrows.

items.Properties / Flavor: A heavy two-handed iron sledgehammer designed to deliver concussive structural demolition blows. Miners and sappers use it to break stone boulders, crack masonry, and drive foundation piles.
items.Description & Mechanics: A heavy two-handed iron sledgehammer designed to deliver concussive structural demolition blows. Miners and sappers use it to break stone boulders, crack masonry, and drive foundation piles.

items.Properties / Flavor: A heavy forged iron pickaxe with a pointed beak on one end and a broad chisel on the other. Miners use it to quarry ore veins, chip through cavern stone, and excavate cave-ins.
items.Description & Mechanics: A heavy forged iron pickaxe with a pointed beak on one end and a broad chisel on the other. Miners use it to quarry ore veins, chip through cavern stone, and excavate cave-ins.

items.Properties / Flavor: This +1 pick deals double damage against stone constructs and can punch through solid rock walls with surprising ease. A reinforced pick-axe head of tempered dark iron is balanced by a blunt hammer face on a heavy haft.
items.Description & Mechanics: This +1 pick deals double damage against stone constructs and can punch through solid rock walls with surprising ease. A reinforced pick-axe head of tempered dark iron is balanced by a blunt hammer face on a heavy haft.

items.Properties / Flavor: A lightweight river vessel crafted from cedar ribs and waterproofed birch bark that carries up to six passengers. It navigates shallow jungle rapids easily and can be portaged between waterways.
items.Description & Mechanics: A lightweight river vessel crafted from cedar ribs and waterproofed birch bark that carries up to six passengers. It navigates shallow jungle rapids easily and can be portaged between waterways.

items.Properties / Flavor: A hardy desert pack animal capable of carrying heavy freight across scorching dunes for days without water. It serves caravan routes traversing the Anauroch desert with endurance.
items.Description & Mechanics: A hardy desert pack animal capable of carrying heavy freight across scorching dunes for days without water. It serves caravan routes traversing the Anauroch desert with endurance.

items.Properties / Flavor: A simple two-wheeled wooden wagon designed to be pulled by a single draft horse, mule, or ox. It carries up to two hundred pounds of produce or expedition equipment over rough dirt roads.
items.Description & Mechanics: A simple two-wheeled wooden wagon designed to be pulled by a single draft horse, mule, or ox. It carries up to two hundred pounds of produce or expedition equipment over rough dirt roads.

items.Properties / Flavor: A formidable warship propelled by multiple tiers of rowing oars alongside square-rigged sails. It features reinforced naval rams and fighting decks designed to board opposing sea vessels.
items.Description & Mechanics: A formidable warship propelled by multiple tiers of rowing oars alongside square-rigged sails. It features reinforced naval rams and fighting decks designed to board opposing sea vessels.

items.Properties / Flavor: A simple wooden dinghy fitted with two wooden oars and rowlocks, carrying up to three passengers. Ships carry them as shore landing craft, and fishermen row them across calm harbor waters.
items.Description & Mechanics: A simple wooden dinghy fitted with two wooden oars and rowlocks, carrying up to three passengers. Ships carry them as shore landing craft, and fishermen row them across calm harbor waters.

items.Properties / Flavor: A tapered, heavy wooden cavalry weapon built to channel the full kinetic momentum of a galloping mount. It pierces heavily armored knights at full tilt, though it proves cumbersome when unmounted.
items.Description & Mechanics: A tapered, heavy wooden cavalry weapon built to channel the full kinetic momentum of a galloping mount. It pierces heavily armored knights at full tilt, though it proves cumbersome when unmounted.

items.Properties / Flavor: A thick-furred northern husky trained to pull heavy sleds through sub-zero blizzards and mountain passes. Highly loyal and resilient, a team of dogs can haul cargo across frozen wastes for days.
items.Description & Mechanics: A thick-furred northern husky trained to pull heavy sleds through sub-zero blizzards and mountain passes. Highly loyal and resilient, a team of dogs can haul cargo across frozen wastes for days.

items.Properties / Flavor: A fist-sized bronze carving of a regal griffon rearing with outstretched talons. Speaking its command word transforms the figurine into a living griffon mount for up to six hours.
items.Description & Mechanics: A fist-sized bronze carving of a regal griffon rearing with outstretched talons. Speaking its command word transforms the figurine into a living griffon mount for up to six hours.

items.Description & Mechanics: Three goat figurines carved from polished ivory, each with unique horns and posture. They transform into a swift traveling mount, a combat battering goat, or a giant terrorizing steed.

items.Properties / Flavor: A black glass carving of a rearing stallion that feels cold and sharp to the touch. It transforms into an obedient nightmare mount that flies across planar skies and ethereal realms.
items.Description & Mechanics: A black glass carving of a rearing stallion that feels cold and sharp to the touch. It transforms into an obedient nightmare mount that flies across planar skies and ethereal realms.

items.Properties / Flavor: A green serpentine stone carving of a perched owl with wide observant eyes. It animates into either a normal scouting owl or a giant flying owl capable of serving as an aerial mount.
items.Description & Mechanics: A green serpentine stone carving of a perched owl with wide observant eyes. It animates into either a normal scouting owl or a giant flying owl capable of serving as an aerial mount.

items.Properties / Flavor: A sure-footed beast of burden known for stubborn resilience and load-bearing stamina along steep mountain paths. It hauls up to four hundred and twenty pounds of mining gear or treasure.
items.Description & Mechanics: A sure-footed beast of burden known for stubborn resilience and load-bearing stamina along steep mountain paths. It hauls up to four hundred and twenty pounds of mining gear or treasure.

items.Properties / Flavor: A swift, agile equine bred for overland travel, courier dispatch, and light scouting. It covers great distances daily at a rapid trot, though it lacks heavy combat training.
items.Description & Mechanics: A swift, agile equine bred for overland travel, courier dispatch, and light scouting. It covers great distances daily at a rapid trot, though it lacks heavy combat training.

items.Properties / Flavor: A stout, short horse perfectly proportioned to serve as a mount for dwarves, gnomes, and halflings. It navigates tight subterranean tunnels and mountain switchbacks with sure-footed stability.
items.Description & Mechanics: A stout, short horse perfectly proportioned to serve as a mount for dwarves, gnomes, and halflings. It navigates tight subterranean tunnels and mountain switchbacks with sure-footed stability.

items.Properties / Flavor: A magnificent armored equine trained specifically to charge into the chaos and clamor of melee combat. It wears barding comfortably and tramples fallen foes with crushing iron-shod hooves.
items.Description & Mechanics: A magnificent armored equine trained specifically to charge into the chaos and clamor of melee combat. It wears barding comfortably and tramples fallen foes with crushing iron-shod hooves.

items.Properties / Flavor: A heavy blanket of interlocking steel rings draped over a quilted gambeson to armor a war mount. It shields the horse's flank and chest against slicing blades during cavalry charges.
items.Description & Mechanics: A heavy blanket of interlocking steel rings draped over a quilted gambeson to armor a war mount. It shields the horse's flank and chest against slicing blades during cavalry charges.

items.Properties / Flavor: Speaking the command word transforms this ivory figurine into a skeletal warhorse mount for up to eight hours once per week. Carved from mammoth tusk, the miniature equine sculpture has hollow ruby eyes.
items.Description & Mechanics: Speaking the command word transforms this ivory figurine into a skeletal warhorse mount for up to eight hours once per week. Carved from mammoth tusk, the miniature equine sculpture has hollow ruby eyes.

items.Properties / Flavor: A green feather inscribed with arboreal runes that erupts into a sixty-foot oak tree when planted. The instantaneous wooden trunk provides instant elevation, climbing holds, or barricade cover.
items.Description & Mechanics: A green feather inscribed with arboreal runes that erupts into a sixty-foot oak tree when planted. The instantaneous wooden trunk provides instant elevation, climbing holds, or barricade cover.

items.Properties / Flavor: A petrified heart of rough obsidian that pulses with subterranean mineral vibrations when held. Placing it against your chest grants total immunity to petrification and turns your skin into resilient living granite.
items.Description & Mechanics: A petrified heart of rough obsidian that pulses with subterranean mineral vibrations when held. Placing it against your chest grants total immunity to petrification and turns your skin into resilient living granite.

items.Properties / Flavor: This staff lets you cast pass without trace, spike growth, and tree stride to navigate ancient virgin woodlands. Polished white birch wood is capped with a clear river quartz wrapped in silvered bramble vines.
items.Description & Mechanics: This staff lets you cast pass without trace, spike growth, and tree stride to navigate ancient virgin woodlands. Polished white birch wood is capped with a clear river quartz wrapped in silvered bramble vines.

items.Properties / Flavor: A massive two-handed sword carved from a single volcanic obsidian glass spire banded with gold. It lands razor-sharp critical strikes that inflict lingering bleeding wounds and shatter wooden shields.
items.Description & Mechanics: A massive two-handed sword carved from a single volcanic obsidian glass spire banded with gold. It lands razor-sharp critical strikes that inflict lingering bleeding wounds and shatter wooden shields.

items.Properties / Flavor: This +1 double-bladed scimitar allows the wielder to make an extra bonus action strike dealing 1d4 slashing damage. Dual curved steel blades are attached to a central wood haft bound in Valenar horsehair.
items.Description & Mechanics: This +1 double-bladed scimitar allows the wielder to make an extra bonus action strike dealing 1d4 slashing damage. Dual curved steel blades are attached to a central wood haft bound in Valenar horsehair.

items.Properties / Flavor: A sturdy four-wheeled freight hauler built with high wooden slat walls and a driver's bench. Pulled by a team of draft horses, it transports bulk expedition supplies across long trade roads.
items.Description & Mechanics: A sturdy four-wheeled freight hauler built with high wooden slat walls and a driver's bench. Pulled by a team of draft horses, it transports bulk expedition supplies across long trade roads.

items.Properties / Flavor: A broad wooden disc rimmed with iron and strapped to the forearm to parry melee strikes and catch missile fire. It grants essential defensive warding to any warrior holding the line.
items.Description & Mechanics: A broad wooden disc rimmed with iron and strapped to the forearm to parry melee strikes and catch missile fire. It grants essential defensive warding to any warrior holding the line.

items.Properties / Flavor: A wooden buckler reinforced with iron bands and centered with a sharp, protruding nine-inch steel spike. It allows a skilled defender to bash opponents in melee, dealing piercing damage during close skirmishes.
items.Description & Mechanics: A wooden buckler reinforced with iron bands and centered with a sharp, protruding nine-inch steel spike. It allows a skilled defender to bash opponents in melee, dealing piercing damage during close skirmishes.

items.Properties / Flavor: A custom-tailored suit of boiled leather armor fitted with articulated joints to protect an equine mount. It provides essential protection against arrows and glancing cuts without overburdening the beast.
items.Description & Mechanics: A custom-tailored suit of boiled leather armor fitted with articulated joints to protect an equine mount. It provides essential protection against arrows and glancing cuts without overburdening the beast.

items.Properties / Flavor: Articulated polished steel plates custom-forged to fit a warhorse's neck, head, and flanks. It transforms a noble steed into an armored juggernaut capable of shattering enemy spear lines.
items.Description & Mechanics: Articulated polished steel plates custom-forged to fit a warhorse's neck, head, and flanks. It transforms a noble steed into an armored juggernaut capable of shattering enemy spear lines.

items.Description & Mechanics: These robes provide AC 13 + Dexterity modifier and grant immunity to the suffocation and vacuum penalties of outer planes. Swirling fabric woven from astral dark-matter flutters as if touched by cosmic winds.

items.Description & Mechanics: A belt of tough red dragon leather fastened with a carved jade buckle depicting a coiled lung dragon. It provides a +2 bonus to monk ki save DCs and allows the wearer to regain ki in a surge.

items.Description & Mechanics: A soft leather or drawstring cloth pouch that cinches tightly around a traveling belt. It stores up to twenty coins, spell components, sling stones, or small gemstones safely.

items.Description & Mechanics: A thick belt of cured mammoth hide fastened with an iron buckle depicting a hill giant skull. It surges with primal vigor that elevates the wearer's physical strength to superhuman levels.

items.Description & Mechanics: Crude armor fashioned from thick tanned pelts and cured hides of monstrous beasts. Barbarians and wilderness nomads wear it for essential torso protection without needing forged metal.

items.Description & Mechanics: A suit of wild leather armor crafted from the pelt of an apex beast guardian that pulses with primal rage. It enhances wild shape forms, grants regeneration, and turns physical attacks aside.

items.Description & Mechanics: A compact water-resistant canvas pack holding a hammock, camouflage tarp, snares, and field rations. It equips woodland rangers and scouts to survive comfortably in dense forest canopies.

items.Properties / Flavor: A polished band of woven platinum inlaid with protective runes that gleam with soft luminescence. Wearing it envelops the user in a continuous ward that deflects attacks and resists spells.

items.Properties / Flavor: A flat-ended iron rod featuring a small push button recessed into one end of its grip. Depressing the button anchors the rod in mid-air against thousands of pounds of applied force.
items.Description & Mechanics: A flat-ended iron rod featuring a small push button recessed into one end of its grip. Depressing the button anchors the rod in mid-air against thousands of pounds of applied force.

items.Properties / Flavor: A thick glass vial filled with corrosive yellowish fluid that hisses when exposed to moisture. Hurling it splashes caustic liquid that dissolves organic matter and burns flesh on contact.
items.Description & Mechanics: A thick glass vial filled with corrosive yellowish fluid that hisses when exposed to moisture. Hurling it splashes caustic liquid that dissolves organic matter and burns flesh on contact.

items.Properties / Flavor: A whimsical brass pendant shaped like a sleeping feline filled with dried aromatic catmint leaves. It charms mundane felines and grants its wearer subtle feline grace and balance.
items.Description & Mechanics: A whimsical brass pendant shaped like a sleeping feline filled with dried aromatic catmint leaves. It charms mundane felines and grants its wearer subtle feline grace and balance.

items.Properties / Flavor: A massive, intelligent pachyderm trained to carry war howdahs and trample opposing battle lines. It hauls immense cargo timbers and serves as an imposing status mount for foreign dignitaries.
items.Description & Mechanics: A massive, intelligent pachyderm trained to carry war howdahs and trample opposing battle lines. It hauls immense cargo timbers and serves as an imposing status mount for foreign dignitaries.

items.Properties / Flavor: Four iron shoes forged for a horse or war mount that glow with faint aerodynamic enchantments. When shoed on an equine mount, they increase its base movement speed by thirty feet.
items.Description & Mechanics: Four iron shoes forged for a horse or war mount that glow with faint aerodynamic enchantments. When shoed on an equine mount, they increase its base movement speed by thirty feet.

items.Description & Mechanics: Delicate mithral horseshoes that allow a mount to tread four inches above any ground or liquid surface. The mount leaves no tracks and can gallop across water, mud, lava, and quicksand without sinking.

items.Properties / Flavor: A miniature sculpture of a horsefly carved from solid jet and polished to a glassy sheen. It transforms into a horse-sized flying insect mount that carries you across rugged mountain terrain.
items.Description & Mechanics: A miniature sculpture of a horsefly carved from solid jet and polished to a glassy sheen. It transforms into a horse-sized flying insect mount that carries you across rugged mountain terrain.

items.Properties / Flavor: A muscular, broad-chested workhorse bred specifically for pulling heavy freight wagons and farm plows. It possesses great physical fortitude, moving ponderously under immense strain.
items.Description & Mechanics: A muscular, broad-chested workhorse bred specifically for pulling heavy freight wagons and farm plows. It possesses great physical fortitude, moving ponderously under immense strain.

items.Properties / Flavor: A heavily reinforced naval vessel armed with ballistas and catapults to control coastal sea lanes. Its armored hull resists boarding actions and delivers devastating naval bombardments.
items.Description & Mechanics: A heavily reinforced naval vessel armed with ballistas and catapults to control coastal sea lanes. Its armored hull resists boarding actions and delivers devastating naval bombardments.

items.Description & Mechanics: Spinning this massive wagon wheel weapon unleashes radiant bursts that crush undead and banish corrupt aberrations. A jagged wooden wheel bound with heavy spiked iron rims is fitted with holy prayer scriptures.

items.Description & Mechanics: Loading these silver-mercury rounds into a firearm empowers shots to count as magical and deal extra damage against shapeshifters. Heavy paper-wrapped cartridges contain gleaming liquid metal and refined alchemical powder.

items.Properties / Flavor: A coarse burlap bag that holds up to thirty pounds or one cubic foot of loose gear. Explorers carry multiple folded sacks to haul out loose coins, ore, and salvaged dungeon goods.
items.Description & Mechanics: A coarse burlap bag that holds up to thirty pounds or one cubic foot of loose gear. Explorers carry multiple folded sacks to haul out loose coins, ore, and salvaged dungeon goods.

items.Properties / Flavor: A short curved crescent blade inscribed with autumn harvest runes that cuts grain and vines with ease. Striking plant creatures or blights deals maximum damage and reaps curative life energy.
items.Description & Mechanics: A short curved crescent blade inscribed with autumn harvest runes that cuts grain and vines with ease. Striking plant creatures or blights deals maximum damage and reaps curative life energy.

items.Properties / Flavor: A thick woven blanket of raw wool that retains body heat even when damp from mountain mist. It provides crucial thermal insulation for campers sleeping under open starry skies.
items.Description & Mechanics: A thick woven blanket of raw wool that retains body heat even when damp from mountain mist. It provides crucial thermal insulation for campers sleeping under open starry skies.

items.Properties / Flavor: You can use an action to surround yourself in heavy fog and teleport up to thirty feet to an unoccupied space you can see. Silvery-gray vapor constantly curls along the hem of this lightweight woolen cloak.
items.Description & Mechanics: You can use an action to surround yourself in heavy fog and teleport up to thirty feet to an unoccupied space you can see. Silvery-gray vapor constantly curls along the hem of this lightweight woolen cloak.

items.Properties / Flavor: A full-length suit of thousands of hand-riveted steel rings worn over padded wool gambesons. It provides comprehensive body protection against slicing weapons at the cost of considerable weight.
items.Description & Mechanics: A full-length suit of thousands of hand-riveted steel rings worn over padded wool gambesons. It provides comprehensive body protection against slicing weapons at the cost of considerable weight.

items.Properties / Flavor: A heavy set comprising iron tongs, shaping hammers, files, an apron, and quenching chisels. It equips a blacksmith to forge weapons, repair battered armor, and reshape structural metalwork.
items.Description & Mechanics: A heavy set comprising iron tongs, shaping hammers, files, an apron, and quenching chisels. It equips a blacksmith to forge weapons, repair battered armor, and reshape structural metalwork.

items.Properties / Flavor: A compact forearm gauntlet linked to a pressurized naphtha cartridge strapped to your belt. Pulling the ring trigger projects a twenty-foot jet of roaring liquid flame across enemy ranks.
items.Description & Mechanics: A compact forearm gauntlet linked to a pressurized naphtha cartridge strapped to your belt. Pulling the ring trigger projects a twenty-foot jet of roaring liquid flame across enemy ranks.

items.Properties / Flavor: A sturdy farm flail reinforced with iron hoops and barbed nails favored by gallus militia. It strikes over shields with crushing momentum, knocking down armored opponents in rural skirmishes.
items.Description & Mechanics: A sturdy farm flail reinforced with iron hoops and barbed nails favored by gallus militia. It strikes over shields with crushing momentum, knocking down armored opponents in rural skirmishes.

items.Properties / Flavor: Spiked iron fist wraps incorporating the calcified claw bones of a subterranean ghoul. Striking an opponent injects paralyzing necrotic bile that immobilizes humanoid targets for one minute.
items.Description & Mechanics: Spiked iron fist wraps incorporating the calcified claw bones of a subterranean ghoul. Striking an opponent injects paralyzing necrotic bile that immobilizes humanoid targets for one minute.

items.Properties / Flavor: Critical hits with this +2 maul trigger a concussive shockwave that deafens and knocks prone creatures within fifteen feet. A heavy storm-cloud anvil head is forged from electrified sky-iron and bound in leather.
items.Description & Mechanics: Critical hits with this +2 maul trigger a concussive shockwave that deafens and knocks prone creatures within fifteen feet. A heavy storm-cloud anvil head is forged from electrified sky-iron and bound in leather.

items.Properties / Flavor: This +1 greataxe decapitates stunned or incapacitated enemies, dealing an extra 3d12 damage on prone targets. A massive crescent of blackened carbon iron is stained with ancient dried blood along its broad head.
items.Description & Mechanics: This +1 greataxe decapitates stunned or incapacitated enemies, dealing an extra 3d12 damage on prone targets. A massive crescent of blackened carbon iron is stained with ancient dried blood along its broad head.

items.Properties / Flavor: A solid sphere of polished obsidian or leaded glass that refracts raw weave energy. Sorcerers and wizards hold it in the palm to focus destructive evocation and abjuration magic.
items.Description & Mechanics: A solid sphere of polished obsidian or leaded glass that refracts raw weave energy. Sorcerers and wizards hold it in the palm to focus destructive evocation and abjuration magic.

items.Properties / Flavor: A coarse linen traveling mantle treated with desert alchemicals that whips with grit in the wind. Spinning the cloak unleashes a blinding vortex of stinging sand that obscures vision and blinds foes.
items.Description & Mechanics: A coarse linen traveling mantle treated with desert alchemicals that whips with grit in the wind. Spinning the cloak unleashes a blinding vortex of stinging sand that obscures vision and blinds foes.

items.Properties / Flavor: A rubbery cloak fashioned from the hide of a deep-sea whale that smells of salt and dark depths. It grants underwater breathing, cold immunity, blindsight out to sixty feet, and crushing ocean resilience.
items.Description & Mechanics: A rubbery cloak fashioned from the hide of a deep-sea whale that smells of salt and dark depths. It grants underwater breathing, cold immunity, blindsight out to sixty feet, and crushing ocean resilience.

items.Properties / Flavor: A silky gray-green traveling cloak woven by elven artisans from shadow-threaded woodland fibers. Pulling up the hood camouflages the wearer into surroundings, granting advantage on stealth checks.
items.Description & Mechanics: A silky gray-green traveling cloak woven by elven artisans from shadow-threaded woodland fibers. Pulling up the hood camouflages the wearer into surroundings, granting advantage on stealth checks.

items.Properties / Flavor: A compact kit containing leather awls, cobbler's hammers, curved needles, lasting pliers, and resin thread. It permits cobblers to repair boots, reinforce traveling soles, and craft hidden heel compartments.
items.Description & Mechanics: A compact kit containing leather awls, cobbler's hammers, curved needles, lasting pliers, and resin thread. It permits cobblers to repair boots, reinforce traveling soles, and craft hidden heel compartments.

items.Properties / Flavor: A leather-wrapped deck of hand-painted cards imbued with eccentric planar wild magic. Drawing cards manifests varied utility effects ranging from spectral steed summons to spontaneous weather shifts.
items.Description & Mechanics: A leather-wrapped deck of hand-painted cards imbued with eccentric planar wild magic. Drawing cards manifests varied utility effects ranging from spectral steed summons to spontaneous weather shifts.

items.Properties / Flavor: A pair of linked leather saddlebags designed for horses or griffons with extradimensional depth. They store up to one thousand pounds of expedition supplies without burdening the mount.
items.Description & Mechanics: A pair of linked leather saddlebags designed for horses or griffons with extradimensional depth. They store up to one thousand pounds of expedition supplies without burdening the mount.

items.Properties / Flavor: A hardened leather skullcap mounted with carved stag antlers that pulse with wilderness instinct. It grants advantage on initiative rolls and allows the wearer to gore charging enemies in melee.
items.Description & Mechanics: A hardened leather skullcap mounted with carved stag antlers that pulse with wilderness instinct. It grants advantage on initiative rolls and allows the wearer to gore charging enemies in melee.

items.Properties / Flavor: A small glass phial filled with enchanted blood that hangs from a leather thong around the neck. It boosts sorcerer spell attack rolls and DCs while replenishing sorcery points during rests.
items.Description & Mechanics: A small glass phial filled with enchanted blood that hangs from a leather thong around the neck. It boosts sorcerer spell attack rolls and DCs while replenishing sorcery points during rests.

items.Properties / Flavor: A handheld leather drum painted with swirling musical runes that beats with an internal rhythm. It increases bard spell save DCs and attack rolls while replenishing a Bardic Inspiration die.
items.Description & Mechanics: A handheld leather drum painted with swirling musical runes that beats with an internal rhythm. It increases bard spell save DCs and attack rolls while replenishing a Bardic Inspiration die.

items.Properties / Flavor: A braided leather lash extending ten feet that cracks sharply through the air at supersonic speed. Finesse fighters use its supple reach to distract enemies, trip legs, or strike from safety.
items.Description & Mechanics: A braided leather lash extending ten feet that cracks sharply through the air at supersonic speed. Finesse fighters use its supple reach to distract enemies, trip legs, or strike from safety.

items.Properties / Flavor: A braided cable of alchemical copper links that crackles with dancing blue electrical arcs. Snapping the whip delivers shockwave thunder and pulls distant enemies ten feet closer.
items.Description & Mechanics: A braided cable of alchemical copper links that crackles with dancing blue electrical arcs. Snapping the whip delivers shockwave thunder and pulls distant enemies ten feet closer.

items.Properties / Flavor: A flexible green vine covered in hardened briar thorns that coils like a living serpent in your hand. Striking a target restrains them in barbed thorns, inflicting lingering piercing damage.
items.Description & Mechanics: A flexible green vine covered in hardened briar thorns that coils like a living serpent in your hand. Striking a target restrains them in barbed thorns, inflicting lingering piercing damage.

items.Properties / Flavor: A ten-foot lash crafted from the muscular tentacle of a displacer beast tipped with horn pads. It strikes with reach, deals bonus force damage, and projects a shimmering optical decoy of the wielder.
items.Description & Mechanics: A ten-foot lash crafted from the muscular tentacle of a displacer beast tipped with horn pads. It strikes with reach, deals bonus force damage, and projects a shimmering optical decoy of the wielder.

items.Properties / Flavor: This concealed weapon shifts between a rigid bludgeoning cane and a razor-segmented bladed whip with fifteen-foot reach. Polished mahogany wood conceals tempered segmented steel links bound by braided piano wire.
items.Description & Mechanics: This concealed weapon shifts between a rigid bludgeoning cane and a razor-segmented bladed whip with fifteen-foot reach. Polished mahogany wood conceals tempered segmented steel links bound by braided piano wire.

items.Properties / Flavor: A heavy cloth bag containing 3d4 dried beans that crackle with volatile transmutation magic. Planting a bean in dirt and watering it produces random magical phenomena ranging from fruit trees to hungry monsters.
items.Description & Mechanics: A heavy cloth bag containing 3d4 dried beans that crackle with volatile transmutation magic. Planting a bean in dirt and watering it produces random magical phenomena ranging from fruit trees to hungry monsters.

items.Properties / Flavor: A preserved kelp necklace strung with dried sea beans that can be crushed in the fist. Breaking a bean casts plant growth or speak with plants to compel aquatic vegetation.
items.Description & Mechanics: A preserved kelp necklace strung with dried sea beans that can be crushed in the fist. Breaking a bean casts plant growth or speak with plants to compel aquatic vegetation.

items.Description & Mechanics: A rich purple-red elixir with a warm, pulsing glow that accelerates cellular regeneration on contact. It reknits traumatic injuries and restores substantial vigor to gravely wounded adventurers.

items.Properties / Flavor: A rod of dark iron carved with eldritch runes that glow with eerie green light. It increases warlock spell save DCs and attack rolls while replenishing one expended spell slot daily.
items.Description & Mechanics: A rod of dark iron carved with eldritch runes that glow with eerie green light. It increases warlock spell save DCs and attack rolls while replenishing one expended spell slot daily.

items.Properties / Flavor: A delicate band of spun electrum that hums with rapid reactive energy when danger nears. Expending its charges turns a failed Dexterity saving throw into a complete success.
items.Description & Mechanics: A delicate band of spun electrum that hums with rapid reactive energy when danger nears. Expending its charges turns a failed Dexterity saving throw into a complete success.

items.Properties / Flavor: Crafted with a dense steel head and an armor-puncturing back-spike, this versatile bludgeon delivers concussive trauma. It can be swung with either one hand or braced with both for bone-shattering force.
items.Description & Mechanics: Crafted with a dense steel head and an armor-puncturing back-spike, this versatile bludgeon delivers concussive trauma. It can be swung with either one hand or braced with both for bone-shattering force.

items.Properties / Flavor: A simple rounded length of solid hardwood balanced for one-handed bludgeoning strikes. It is one of the most basic, accessible implements of defense found throughout taverns and homesteads.
items.Description & Mechanics: A simple rounded length of solid hardwood balanced for one-handed bludgeoning strikes. It is one of the most basic, accessible implements of defense found throughout taverns and homesteads.

items.Properties / Flavor: A heavy two-handed bough reinforced with iron studs to deliver sweeping, bone-breaking blows. Primitive brutes and desperate peasants swing it with momentum to knock opponents sprawling.
items.Description & Mechanics: A heavy two-handed bough reinforced with iron studs to deliver sweeping, bone-breaking blows. Primitive brutes and desperate peasants swing it with momentum to knock opponents sprawling.

items.Properties / Flavor: A colossal two-handed sledgehammer forged from solid iron to deliver immense crushing force. It shatters stone barricades, splinters wooden gates, and obliterates reinforced armor.
items.Description & Mechanics: A colossal two-handed sledgehammer forged from solid iron to deliver immense crushing force. It shatters stone barricades, splinters wooden gates, and obliterates reinforced armor.

items.Properties / Flavor: A stubby, thick-bored blackpowder hand cannon designed to unleash massive lead grapeshot at close quarters. It delivers terrifying concussive stopping power capable of knocking charging beasts off their feet.
items.Description & Mechanics: A stubby, thick-bored blackpowder hand cannon designed to unleash massive lead grapeshot at close quarters. It delivers terrifying concussive stopping power capable of knocking charging beasts off their feet.

items.Properties / Flavor: A traditional military long gun utilizing a matchlock mechanism to fire heavy lead balls. It produces a massive smoke bloom and loud thunderclap that punches cleanly through thick armor.
items.Description & Mechanics: A traditional military long gun utilizing a matchlock mechanism to fire heavy lead balls. It produces a massive smoke bloom and loud thunderclap that punches cleanly through thick armor.

items.Properties / Flavor: A massive two-handed executioner's axe forged with a heavy crescent blade designed for cleaving blows. Barbarians and frontline berserkers swing it with momentum to cleave through shields and bone.
items.Description & Mechanics: A massive two-handed executioner's axe forged with a heavy crescent blade designed for cleaving blows. Barbarians and frontline berserkers swing it with momentum to cleave through shields and bone.

items.Properties / Flavor: A versatile warhammer whose flanged head and rear spike are encased in dense alchemical silver. It delivers concussive blunt force that shatters gargoyles and repels silver-vulnerable abominations.
items.Description & Mechanics: A versatile warhammer whose flanged head and rear spike are encased in dense alchemical silver. It delivers concussive blunt force that shatters gargoyles and repels silver-vulnerable abominations.

items.Properties / Flavor: An insulated steel baton fitted with conductive copper terminals powered by a grip battery cell. Striking a target delivers nonlethal electrical shocks that stun and disarm opponents.
items.Description & Mechanics: An insulated steel baton fitted with conductive copper terminals powered by a grip battery cell. Striking a target delivers nonlethal electrical shocks that stun and disarm opponents.

items.Properties / Flavor: A longsword forged from unworked, unheated cold iron mined deep beneath ancient haunted hills. It pierces the natural resistances of fey creatures, fiends, and incorporeal phantoms.
items.Description & Mechanics: A longsword forged from unworked, unheated cold iron mined deep beneath ancient haunted hills. It pierces the natural resistances of fey creatures, fiends, and incorporeal phantoms.

items.Properties / Flavor: A bundle of twenty ash shafts tipped with steel bodkin heads and fletched with goose feathers. They fit neatly into any standard quiver to supply archers on lengthy campaigns.
items.Description & Mechanics: A bundle of twenty ash shafts tipped with steel bodkin heads and fletched with goose feathers. They fit neatly into any standard quiver to supply archers on lengthy campaigns.

items.Properties / Flavor: Six six-sided dice carved from polished animal bone with carved black pips stored in a velvet pouch. Gamblers and tavern patrons roll them in popular betting games across Waterdeep's drinking dens.
items.Description & Mechanics: Six six-sided dice carved from polished animal bone with carved black pips stored in a velvet pouch. Gamblers and tavern patrons roll them in popular betting games across Waterdeep's drinking dens.

items.Properties / Flavor: A wind instrument consisting of a sealed leather air bladder, a blowpipe, and tuned wooden drones. Its piercing, drone-heavy chords carry across windswept highlands to rally marching highland clans.
items.Description & Mechanics: A wind instrument consisting of a sealed leather air bladder, a blowpipe, and tuned wooden drones. Its piercing, drone-heavy chords carry across windswept highlands to rally marching highland clans.

items.Properties / Flavor: A slender side-blown musical tube crafted from polished cherrywood or bone with precision finger holes. It produces sweet, clear bird-like melodies favored by wandering minstrels and pastoral bards.
items.Description & Mechanics: A slender side-blown musical tube crafted from polished cherrywood or bone with precision finger holes. It produces sweet, clear bird-like melodies favored by wandering minstrels and pastoral bards.

items.Properties / Flavor: A classic fretted string instrument with a pear-shaped bowl back and an angled tuning pegbox. It provides rich acoustic accompaniment for courtly singing, ballads, and bardic spellcasting.
items.Description & Mechanics: A classic fretted string instrument with a pear-shaped bowl back and an angled tuning pegbox. It provides rich acoustic accompaniment for courtly singing, ballads, and bardic spellcasting.

items.Properties / Flavor: A one-handed utility hammer fitted with a flat striking face and a straight claw for pulling spikes. It is an indispensable tool for securing pitons, driving wedges, and camp construction.
items.Description & Mechanics: A one-handed utility hammer fitted with a flat striking face and a straight claw for pulling spikes. It is an indispensable tool for securing pitons, driving wedges, and camp construction.

items.Properties / Flavor: A crisp, lightweight sheet made from pressed wood pulp and cotton rags suitable for rapid writing. It is less durable than treated vellum but provides an affordable medium for letters.
items.Description & Mechanics: A crisp, lightweight sheet made from pressed wood pulp and cotton rags suitable for rapid writing. It is less durable than treated vellum but provides an affordable medium for letters.

items.Properties / Flavor: A hand torch connected to pressurized acetylene and oxygen canisters that generates white-hot flame. It cuts through iron bars, welds broken steel gates, and mends damaged automatons.
items.Description & Mechanics: A hand torch connected to pressurized acetylene and oxygen canisters that generates white-hot flame. It cuts through iron bars, welds broken steel gates, and mends damaged automatons.

items.Properties / Flavor: A heavy oak warhammer imbued with surprising kinetic momentum that hums when swung. Landing a strike on a creature has a chance to knock the target completely prone onto the ground.
items.Description & Mechanics: A heavy oak warhammer imbued with surprising kinetic momentum that hums when swung. Landing a strike on a creature has a chance to knock the target completely prone onto the ground.

items.Properties / Flavor: Hanging these metal chimes outside an encampment alerts sleeping allies if an unnatural aberration or undead approaches within sixty feet. Slender silver tubes ring with a crisp melodic chime whenever spiritual danger draws near.

items.Properties / Flavor: Ringing this tiny brass bell creates a sphere of silence that prevents outside eavesdropping within a five-foot radius. Hand-turned brass bell is engraved with quiet monk motifs and muffled by a velvet clapper.
items.Description & Mechanics: Ringing this tiny brass bell creates a sphere of silence that prevents outside eavesdropping within a five-foot radius. Hand-turned brass bell is engraved with quiet monk motifs and muffled by a velvet clapper.

items.Properties / Flavor: A tarnished brass flagon sealed with a heavy lead stopper that feels hot to the touch. Removing the stopper unleashes an endless torrent of thick gray smoke that blinds an entire district.
items.Description & Mechanics: A tarnished brass flagon sealed with a heavy lead stopper that feels hot to the touch. Removing the stopper unleashes an endless torrent of thick gray smoke that blinds an entire district.

items.Properties / Flavor: An alchemically treated wooden dowel that erupts with thick, opaque gray smoke when snapped and struck. It blankets a twenty-foot sphere in dense fog to obscure vision and facilitate hasty retreats.
items.Description & Mechanics: An alchemically treated wooden dowel that erupts with thick, opaque gray smoke when snapped and struck. It blankets a twenty-foot sphere in dense fog to obscure vision and facilitate hasty retreats.

items.Properties / Flavor: A small glass sphere filled with pressurized phosphor salts and powdered magnesium. Shattering it produces a blinding flash and concussive bang that disorients and blinds nearby enemies.
items.Description & Mechanics: A small glass sphere filled with pressurized phosphor salts and powdered magnesium. Shattering it produces a blinding flash and concussive bang that disorients and blinds nearby enemies.

items.Properties / Flavor: A sealed wooden keg containing twenty pounds of volatile alchemical blackpowder equipped with a fuse. Detonating it shatters stone fortifications and blasts all creatures within twenty feet.
items.Description & Mechanics: A sealed wooden keg containing twenty pounds of volatile alchemical blackpowder equipped with a fuse. Detonating it shatters stone fortifications and blasts all creatures within twenty feet.

items.Properties / Flavor: A water-resistant powder horn fashioned from hollow bull horn holding two pounds of blackpowder. It provides enough measured powder charges to fire up to forty firearm rounds.
items.Description & Mechanics: A water-resistant powder horn fashioned from hollow bull horn holding two pounds of blackpowder. It provides enough measured powder charges to fire up to forty firearm rounds.

items.Properties / Flavor: A small metal tube fitted with a magnesium fuse that detonates in a blinding white flash and sharp crack. It momentarily blinds and deafens guards, providing crucial seconds for infiltration.
items.Description & Mechanics: A small metal tube fitted with a magnesium fuse that detonates in a blinding white flash and sharp crack. It momentarily blinds and deafens guards, providing crucial seconds for infiltration.

items.Properties / Flavor: A pressurized container holding cryogenic chemicals that freezes solid upon contact with open air. Shattering it encases targets in brittle frost that slows movement and freezes water.
items.Description & Mechanics: A pressurized container holding cryogenic chemicals that freezes solid upon contact with open air. Shattering it encases targets in brittle frost that slows movement and freezes water.

items.Properties / Flavor: A clear, odorless liquid stored in an airtight lead vial that dissolves glues, resins, and adhesives. Pouring it over bonds or sticky monster webs instantly breaks the adhesive hold.
items.Description & Mechanics: A clear, odorless liquid stored in an airtight lead vial that dissolves glues, resins, and adhesives. Pouring it over bonds or sticky monster webs instantly breaks the adhesive hold.

items.Properties / Flavor: A small glass ampoule containing pungent ammonia and aromatic wintergreen salts. Snapping it under an unconscious or stunned creature's nose immediately awakens them to full consciousness.
items.Description & Mechanics: A small glass ampoule containing pungent ammonia and aromatic wintergreen salts. Snapping it under an unconscious or stunned creature's nose immediately awakens them to full consciousness.

items.Properties / Flavor: Wrapping these herbal linens around a wounded creature stabilizes them instantly and restores 1d4 hit points over ten minutes of rest. Soft woven strips of medicated willow bark are scented with eucalyptus and dried mint.
items.Description & Mechanics: Wrapping these herbal linens around a wounded creature stabilizes them instantly and restores 1d4 hit points over ten minutes of rest. Soft woven strips of medicated willow bark are scented with eucalyptus and dried mint.

items.Description & Mechanics: A bronze brooch shaped like a sling bullet that fastens cleanly onto cloaks or tunics. It magically produces smooth lead sling bullets on command so the bearer never runs out of ammunition.

items.Properties / Flavor: A thick padded wool coat embedded with hundreds of protruding hardened porcupine quills. It protects the torso while dealing retaliatory piercing damage to enemies that attempt to grapple you.
items.Description & Mechanics: A thick padded wool coat embedded with hundreds of protruding hardened porcupine quills. It protects the torso while dealing retaliatory piercing damage to enemies that attempt to grapple you.

items.Properties / Flavor: A heavy crossbow engineered with an enlarged flight track designed to fire sharpened wooden stakes. It allows vampire hunters to deliver lethal piercing stakes from safe tactical range.
items.Description & Mechanics: A heavy crossbow engineered with an enlarged flight track designed to fire sharpened wooden stakes. It allows vampire hunters to deliver lethal piercing stakes from safe tactical range.

items.Description & Mechanics: High leather boots adorned with small white feathered wings that flutter near the ankles. They grant their wearer four hours of flight daily, carrying them effortlessly through the air.

items.Description & Mechanics: A weather-treated oiled canvas shelter with collapsible wooden poles and ground stakes. It offers two adventurers dry shelter and protection from biting winds during long overland travels.

items.Description & Mechanics: A small metal container holding a flint stone, a steel striker, and dry shredded kindling. It enables explorers to strike sparks quickly and kindle torches or campfires in cold environments.

menu.Properties / Flavor: Wild hare braised with shallots, prunes, and dark fortified wine until fork-tender. A classic winter comfort dish favored by North Ward hunting lodges.
menu.Meal Perk / Roleplay Effect: Adventurer's Vigor: Gain +5 Temporary HP until your next rest. [Savory braised hare]

menu.Properties / Flavor: Boned peacock meat layered with pistachio farce, wrapped in edible 24-karat gold leaf, and chilled. Served on a silver pedestal decorated with pristine peacock tail plumes.
menu.Meal Perk / Roleplay Effect: Palatial Vigor: Gain +10 Temporary HP until your next rest. [Edible gold leaf and truffles]

menu.Properties / Flavor: Luminescent blue beluga caviar harvested from deep abyssal sturgeon, served with warm buckwheat blinis. The iridescent eggs pop on the palate with clean ocean brine and faint magical tingling.
menu.Meal Perk / Roleplay Effect: Aristocratic Vitality: Gain +8 Temporary HP until your next rest. [Salt-cured sturgeon pearls]

menu.Properties / Flavor: Layers of whipped clotted cream, feywild dragonfruit, and spun spun sugar crystals that glow in the dark. Each spoonful releases a delicate euphoric warmth in the heart.
menu.Meal Perk / Roleplay Effect: Aristocratic Vitality: Gain +8 Temporary HP until your next rest. [Creamy honeyed ambrosia]

menu.Properties / Flavor: Pan-seared Chilean sea bass basted in champagne butter and topped with white Alba truffle shavings. Served over creamy saffron risotto with microgreens.
menu.Meal Perk / Roleplay Effect: Palatial Vigor: Gain +10 Temporary HP until your next rest. [Pan-seared whitefish in champagne butter]

menu.Properties / Flavor: Paper-thin slices of cold red dragon flank cured with sea salt, lemon zest, and spicy caperberries. The meat leaves a gentle, invigorating heat that warms the core.
menu.Meal Perk / Roleplay Effect: Palatial Vigor: Gain +10 Temporary HP until your next rest. [Delicately shaved red dragon loin]

menu.Properties / Flavor: Watery soup of boiled bitter greens and a scraped marrow bone that has seen five re-boilings. It fills an empty belly when the cold winter wind bites through canvas tents.
menu.Meal Perk / Roleplay Effect: Gutter Cramps: Suffer -2 HP to Hit Dice rolled during your next Short Rest. [Watery, sulfurous gas]

menu.Properties / Flavor: Coarse pig's blood and oatmeal stuffed into casing and roasted until split and blackened over charcoal. Greasy and metallic, but rich in vital iron.
menu.Meal Perk / Roleplay Effect: Gutter Nausea: Disadvantage on your next Constitution saving throw before your next rest. [Bitter metallic aftertaste]

menu.Properties / Flavor: Water boiled with pine needles and dried chicory root in a blackened iron kettle. Pungent and bitter, serving as the poor man's morning pick-me-up.
menu.Meal Perk / Roleplay Effect: None (Weak chicory and weed tea. Fulfills water requirement with zero effects.)

menu.Properties / Flavor: Crispy fried giant bat wings tossed in vinegar and spicy powdered cave fungus. Crunchy and greasy, tasting like gamey duck with a sharp fungal bite.
menu.Meal Perk / Roleplay Effect: Underdark Rush: Gain +5 Temporary HP, but suffer -2 HP to Hit Dice rolled during your next Short Rest. [Musky cave tallow]

menu.Properties / Flavor: Chewy tentacles of deep sea squid pickled in sour vinegar, black peppercorns, and brine. Tough as boot leather, but prized by smuggler captains.
menu.Meal Perk / Roleplay Effect: Caustic Surge: Gain +5 Temporary HP, but take 1d4 acid damage upon consumption. [Numb tongue and throat burn]

menu.Properties / Flavor: Creamy rice folded with bioluminescent blue Underdark mushrooms that emit faint ambient light in the bowl. It tingles on the palate and expands night vision slightly.
menu.Meal Perk / Roleplay Effect: Comforting Hearth: Regain +2 bonus HP per Hit Die rolled during your next Short Rest. [Creamy bioluminescent lichen]

menu.Properties / Flavor: Delicate webs of spun sugar flavored with crushed mint and dark cocoa. It dissolves instantly on the tongue like cold mountain snowflakes.
menu.Meal Perk / Roleplay Effect: Affluent Vitality: Gain +3 Temporary HP until your next rest. [Delicate spun sugar]

menu.Properties / Flavor: Potent corn liquor aged in charred oak barrels smuggled from Amnian moonshiners. It hits with a blinding alcoholic punch that numbs broken bones.
menu.Meal Perk / Roleplay Effect: Sluggish: Disadvantage on your next Initiative roll before your next rest. [Blurred vision and spinning room]

menu.Properties / Flavor: Distilled from fermented fire-beetle glands and subterranean fungi. It burns with an ethereal blue flame when poured into a glass.
menu.Meal Perk / Roleplay Effect: Fire in the Veins: Gain +5 Temporary HP, but disadvantage on your next Constitution saving throw before your next rest. [Feverish flush]
